name: Diclogesic RR Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION

DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION contains Diclofenac, which belongs to a group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION is used to manage various painful conditions such as flare-ups of joint or back pain, gout attacks (a common and complex form of arthritis that is characterized by sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness, and tenderness in one or more joints), pain caused by kidney stones or due to injuries, fractures, or trauma. It is also used to manage or manage pain following an operation. 

Before receiving DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any allergies, heart, liver, or kidney problems, clotting disorders, high blood pressure, diabetes, or any respiratory conditions; gastrointestinal problems such as stomach ulcers, ulcerative colitis, or Crohn's disease; and bleeding in the stomach with symptoms such as black stools or blood in vomit.

DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women, especially if you are more than 6 months pregnant, and it should be used with caution in breast-feeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The common side effects of receiving DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION are nausea and discomfort, pain, redness, or lumps at the site of injection. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects get worse.

usesDetails:
Uses Of DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION

Manages painful conditions such as:

Flare-ups of joint or back pain
Gout attacks
Pain caused by kidney stones or injuries, fractures, or trauma
Pain following an operation
mechanismOfAction:
How DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION Works

DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION works by inhibiting the activity of certain enzymes (called cyclooxygenase (COX) enzymes), which manage the excess production of prostaglandins (which is responsible for causing pain and inflammation), thus helping in managing various painful conditions.
usageDetails:
How to use DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION

DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a muscle (usually into buttocks as an intramuscular injection) or under the skin (usually into buttocks or thighs as a subcutaneous injection) or into a vein (usually in the upper arm as an intravenous injection). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

warnings.details: DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy, especially if you are more than 6 months pregnant, as it may affect the baby’s circulation or damage the baby’s kidney and may delay or prolong your labour. Your doctor may make a decision whether to continue the use of DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION if you are pregnant or planning to get pregnant. Consult your doctor before receiving DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION, as it may make it more difficult to get pregnant during management with this medicine.
DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION should be used in breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy, tired, sleepy, or have blurred vision after receiving DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION.

DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION is not recommended for patients having or having had severe kidney failure and moderate or severe impairment in kidney function. It should be used with caution in patients having or having ever had kidney problems. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION.

DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients having or having had liver failure. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION.
DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION is not recommended for use if you are allergic to diclofenac, aspirin, ibuprofen, or any other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) (such as indomethacin).

DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with history of asthma. It should be used with caution in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) or hay fever. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION.

DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart failure, heart disease, or cerebrovascular disease such as heart attack, stroke, mini-stroke (TIA), or blockages to blood vessels to the heart or brain or who have had an operation to clear or bypass blockages and cerebrovascular bleeding. It should be used with caution in patients with angina, blood clots, high blood pressure, raised cholesterol, or raised triglycerides. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION.
DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult the child's doctor for advice.

DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients. Your doctor may initiate the management with the lowest effective dose. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION.

Others

DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have a history of bleeding in your stomach or bowels after you have taken NSAIDs
Had two or more episodes of stomach or duodenal ulcers or bleeding in the digestive tract
Have a blood clotting disorder
Have a history of bleeding diathesis (specifically cerebrovascular bleeding)
Had operation with high risk of haemorrhage
Are dehydrated
Have suffered from heavy blood loss

Before receiving DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have smoking habit
Have diabetes
Have systemic lupus erythematosus or any similar problem
Have porphyria or nasal polyps
Are recovering from surgery?
Are going to undergo gut surgery?
Have any bowel disorders, including ulcerative colitis or Crohn’s disease

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before receiving DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Other medicines used to provide pain relief (Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure (Ex. captopril, atenolol, metoprolol)
Digoxin (used to manage heart problems)
Methotrexate, pemetrexed (used in cancer management)
Spironolactone, furosemide (used to remove excess water from the body)
Lithium (used to manage mental health problems)
Warfarin or heparin (used to manage or manage blood clots)
Mifepristone (used to terminate pregnancy)
Medicine used to suppress inflammation (Ex. prednisolone)
Medicines used to suppress immunity (Ex. ciclosporin and tacrolimus)
Citalopram (used to manage depression)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. ciprofloxacin, ofloxacin)
Phenytoin (used to manage seizures)
Voriconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Medicines used to lower cholesterol (Ex. colestipol, cholestyramine)
Sulfinpyrazone (used in gout management)
Zidovudine (used in HIV management)
Anti-diabetics such as metformin (used to manage diabetics)
Deferasirox (used to manage iron overload due to blood transfusions)

Overdosage:

DICLOGESIC RR INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse if you experience any unusual symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, stomach or bowel bleeding, dizziness, tinnitus (ringing noise in ears), and occasionally convulsions (fits). In severe cases, it may cause kidney or liver damage (signs include difficulty passing urine or passing more water than usual, tiredness, muscle cramps, swelling in your hands, feet, or face, nausea or vomiting, and yellowing of the skin).

name: Domadol 50mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE

DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE Works

DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE

Take DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy because it may cross the placenta and its safety is not established in pregnant women. If you have severe pain, consult your doctor for advice who has to decide whether you can take single doses.
DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel sleepiness, blurred vision, impaired reaction and dizziness after taking DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE.
Do not consume alcohol while taking DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE as it may increase the effects of this medicine.

DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney insufficiency. It should be taken with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney insufficiency and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval. Consult your doctor before taking DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE.

DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver insufficiency and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval. Consult your doctor before taking DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE.
Do not take DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.
DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with asthma or trouble breathing. Consult your doctor before taking DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE.

Others

DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms (due to addiction of drugs)
Have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions)

Before taking DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick
Had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy
Have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted
Are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia)
Are addicted to morphine
Have tendency to drug addiction or abuse

Use in paediatrics:

DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity symptoms of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

 Use in geriatrics:

DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years) due to delayed excretion of this medicine and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval of DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE. Consult your doctor before taking DOMADOL 50MG CAPSULE.

name: ULTRANISE Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ULTRANISE TABLET

ULTRANISE TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ULTRANISE TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ULTRANISE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ULTRANISE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ULTRANISE TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ULTRANISE TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

How ULTRANISE TABLET Works

ULTRANISE TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRANISE TABLET

Take ULTRANISE TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ULTRANISE TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: ULTRANISE TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
ULTRANISE TABLET is not recommended for use during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel drowsy after taking ULTRANISE TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ULTRANISE TABLET because it might make you feel drowsy and it is not recommended for use in patients with acute alcohol poisoning.
ULTRANISE TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking ULTRANISE TABLET.

ULTRANISE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disorder and should be used with caution in patients with liver problems or jaundice. Consult your doctor before taking ULTRANISE TABLET.
Do not take ULTRANISE TABLET if you are allergic to Paracetamol, Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.
ULTRANISE TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have severe difficulties in breathing like asthma or severe lung problems. Consult your doctor before taking ULTRANISE TABLET.

Others

ULTRANISE TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (which is not adequately controlled by your current medicine)
Known or suspected gastrointestinal obstruction including paralytic ileus

Before taking ULTRANISE TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have epilepsy or already experienced fits or seizures
Have recently suffered from a head injury, shock or severe headaches associated with vomiting
Have intolerance to certain sugars
Have depression

Use in pediatrics:

ULTRANISE TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

ULTRANISE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking ULTRANISE TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. metoclopramide, domperidone or ondansetron)
Medicines used against infections (Ex. ketoconazole, flucloxacillin, erythromycin)
Medicine used to reduce cholesterol in the blood (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicine used in the management of depression or Parkinson’s disease (Ex. monoamine oxidase inhibitors such as phenelzine, isocarboxazid)  
Amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Medicine used to help stop smoking (Ex. bupropion)
Baclofen (used as muscle relaxant)
Warfarin, phenprocoumon (used to manage or manage blood clots)
Medicine used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine)
Morphine, buprenorphine, nalbuphine or pentazocine (used to manage severe pain)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ULTRANISE TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of ULTRANISE TABLET includes loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, malaise, pallor, excess sweating, respiratory depression and seizures.

name: Tramasure Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About TRAMASURE INJECTION

TRAMASURE INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

TRAMASURE INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving TRAMASURE INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRAMASURE INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TRAMASURE INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRAMASURE INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMASURE INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMASURE INJECTION Works

TRAMASURE INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMASURE INJECTION

TRAMASURE INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: TRAMASURE INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women planning to have a baby because the baby may become dependent and may show withdrawal symptoms after the birth. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMASURE INJECTION.
TRAMASURE INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and will affect the baby. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMASURE INJECTION.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impaired reaction after receiving TRAMASURE INJECTION.
Do not consume alcohol while receiving TRAMASURE INJECTION as it may increase the effects of this medicine.
TRAMASURE INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMASURE INJECTION.
TRAMASURE INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMASURE INJECTION.
Do not receive TRAMASURE INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

TRAMASURE INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines)

Before receiving TRAMASURE INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shock state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

TRAMASURE INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of TRAMASURE INJECTION to your child.

Use in geriatrics:

TRAMASURE INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMASURE INJECTION.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Benzodiazepines (medicines used to manage anxiety or sleep problems) Ex. diazepam, lorazepam
Anticoagulants (medicines used to manage or manage blood clots) Ex. warfarin
Carbamazepine (used to manage fits)
Ondansetron (used to manage or manage nausea)
Monoamine oxidase inhibitors (medicines used to manage depression) Ex. moclobemide, phenelzine and selegiline (used to manage parkinson’s disease)
Other medicines used to manage pain (Ex. pentazocine, buprenorphine, morphine, codeine)

Overdosage:

TRAMASURE INJECTION will be administered to you only by a physician or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your physician if you experience any unusual symptoms. Overdosage symptoms of TRAMASURE INJECTION are excessive constriction of pupil of the eye, vomiting, cardiovascular collapse, consciousness disorders up to coma, convulsions, respiratory depression up to respiratory arrest and serotonin syndrome (a serious drug reaction).

DOMADOL PLUS TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. DOMADOL PLUS TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking DOMADOL PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

DOMADOL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking DOMADOL PLUS TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ULTRACET TABLET

ULTRACET TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ULTRACET TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ULTRACET TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ULTRACET TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ULTRACET TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ULTRACET TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ULTRACET TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRACET TABLET Works

ULTRACET TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

How to use ULTRACET TABLET

Take ULTRACET TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ULTRACET TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TYDOL 100MG TABLET

TYDOL 100MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TYDOL 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TYDOL 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TYDOL 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TYDOL 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TYDOL 100MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Uses Of TYDOL 100MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TYDOL 100MG TABLET Works

TYDOL 100MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TYDOL 100MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits

Have lactose intolerance

TYDOL 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking TYDOL 100MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About TAPFREE ER 50 TABLET

TAPFREE ER 50 TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPFREE ER 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPFREE ER 50 TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPFREE ER 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPFREE ER 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPFREE ER 50 TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAPFREE ER 50 TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TAPFREE ER 50 TABLET Works

TAPFREE ER 50 TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPFREE ER 50 TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Take TAPFREE ER 50 TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)

TAPFREE ER 50 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking TAPFREE ER 50 TABLET.

Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits

Interactions

A. Drug–Drug Interactions:

Before taking TAPENAX ER 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Sedatives such as zolpidem, barbiturates (Ex. amobarbital, pentobarbital) antidepressants such as paroxetine, sertraline and anti-psychotics such as loxapine, clozapine, monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) such as isocarboxazid (used to manage depression, anxiety, mood disorders, sleep disturbances) 
Opioids such as codeine, oxymorphone, mixed mu-opioid agonist/antagonists such as pentazocine, nalbuphine, partial mu-opioid agonists such as buprenorphine (used to manage severe pain)
Antihistamines such as cetirizine, loratadine (used to manage allergy)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
St. john’s wort (herbal medicine used to manage depression)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of TAPENAX ER 50 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of TAPENAX ER 50 TABLET are pin-point pupils, vomiting, fast heartbeat, drop in blood pressure, collapse, disturbed consciousness or coma (deep unconsciousness), epileptic fits (convulsions), dangerously slow or shallow breathing or stopping breathing may occur.

introduction:
Introduction About CONTRAMAL SR 100MG TABLET

CONTRAMAL SR 100MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

CONTRAMAL SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking CONTRAMAL SR 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

CONTRAMAL SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. CONTRAMAL SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking CONTRAMAL SR 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CONTRAMAL SR 100MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How CONTRAMAL SR 100MG TABLET Works

CONTRAMAL SR 100MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

name: ZUPRINOR 10 Transdermal Patch 1's
introduction:
Introduction About ZUPRINOR 10 TRANSDERMAL PATCH

ZUPRINOR 10 TRANSDERMAL PATCH contains Buprenorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Strong analgesics. It is used to provide relief from moderate long-lasting pain that requires the use of a strong painkiller in affected individuals.

Pain is an uncomfortable sensation in the body that stems from the activation of nervous system which generally occurs as an annoying or debilitating sensation generally characterized by symptoms such as as a sharp, dull, throbbing, pinching, stinging and/or burning sensation in affected individuals.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while using ZUPRINOR 10 TRANSDERMAL PATCH. This medicine is not recommended for use in patients with breathing problems, addiction to drugs and/or myasthenia gravis (condition that weakness muscles). Before using [GNKEYWORD], inform your doctor if you suffer from sleep apnoea (a breathing related sleep disorder), severe liver problems and/or kidney diseases.

ZUPRINOR 10 TRANSDERMAL PATCH is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

The most common side effects associated with the use of ZUPRINOR 10 TRANSDERMAL PATCH are headache, dizziness, drowsiness, constipation, nausea, vomiting and itchy skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Provides relief from moderate long-lasting pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZUPRINOR 10 TRANSDERMAL PATCH
Provides relief from moderate long-lasting pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ZUPRINOR 10 TRANSDERMAL PATCH Works

ZUPRINOR 10 TRANSDERMAL PATCH works by blocking certain receptors (responsible for pain) in the brain and spinal cord which leads to blockade of pain transmission thus providing relief from moderate and long-lasting pain in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use ZUPRINOR 10 TRANSDERMAL PATCH

Use ZUPRINOR 10 TRANSDERMAL PATCH as advised by your physician. Wash and dry the area where the transdermal patch must be placed. Choose a non-irritated, intact skin, relatively hairless or nearly hairless skin area on your upper arm, outer arm, upper chest, upper back, or side of the chest to apply the patch. The sticky side of the patch is protected with a silvery protective foil which is carefully removed without touching the sticky part of the patch. Stick the patch on to the chosen area of the skin and remove the foil.

Press the patch against the skin with your palm and count to 30 seconds slowly. Ensure, the whole patch is in contact with your skin, especially at the edges. The patch should be worn for seven days. Avoid exposing the patch to extreme heat. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About HITAP ER 50 TABLET

HITAP ER 50 TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

HITAP ER 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

HITAP ER 50 TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

HITAP ER 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. HITAP ER 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking HITAP ER 50 TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of HITAP ER 50 TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How HITAP ER 50 TABLET Works

HITAP ER 50 TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. HITAP ER 50 TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use HITAP ER 50 TABLET

Take HITAP ER 50 TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

HITAP ER 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). It should be used with caution in patients having other breathing issues (slow or shallow breathing). Consult your doctor before taking HITAP ER 50 TABLET.

Others

HITAP ER 50 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

HITAP ER 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.     

 Use in geriatrics:

HITAP ER 50 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking HITAP ER 50 TABLET.

name: Tramazac Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAZAC CAPSULE

TRAMAZAC CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAMAZAC CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAMAZAC CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMAZAC CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAZAC CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAZAC CAPSULE Works

TRAMAZAC CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMAZAC CAPSULE

Take TRAMAZAC CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not consume alcohol while taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE as it may increase the effects of this medicine.

TRAMAZAC CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver insufficiency and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval. Consult your doctor before taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE.
Do not take TRAMAZAC CAPSULE if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.
TRAMAZAC CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with asthma or trouble breathing. Consult your doctor before taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE.

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms (due to addiction of drugs)
Have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions)

Before taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick
Had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy
Have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted
Are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia)
Are addicted to morphine
Have tendency to drug addiction or abuse

Use in paediatrics:

TRAMAZAC CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity symptoms of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

 Use in geriatrics:

TRAMAZAC CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years) due to delayed excretion of this medicine and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval of TRAMAZAC CAPSULE. Consult your doctor before taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE.

Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy

TRAMAZAC CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy because it may cross the placenta and its safety is not established in pregnant women. If you have severe pain, consult your doctor for advice who has to decide whether you can take single doses.

Breastfeeding

TRAMAZAC CAPSULE is not recommended for use more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE.

Driving and Using Machines

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel sleepiness, blurred vision, impaired reaction and dizziness after taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE.

Alcohol

Do not consume alcohol while taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE as it may increase the effects of this medicine.

Kidney

TRAMAZAC CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney insufficiency. It should be taken with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney insufficiency and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval. Consult your doctor before taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE.

Liver

TRAMAZAC CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver insufficiency and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval. Consult your doctor before taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE.

Allergy

Do not take TRAMAZAC CAPSULE if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Lungs

TRAMAZAC CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with asthma or trouble breathing. Consult your doctor before taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE.

Others

TRAMAZAC CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms (due to addiction of drugs)
Have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions)

Before taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick
Had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy
Have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted
Are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia)
Are addicted to morphine
Have tendency to drug addiction or abuse

Use in paediatrics:

TRAMAZAC CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity symptoms of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

 Use in geriatrics:

TRAMAZAC CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years) due to delayed excretion of this medicine and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval of TRAMAZAC CAPSULE. Consult your doctor before taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking TRAMAZAC CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Monoamine oxidase inhibitors (medicines used to manage depression) Ex. isocarboxazid, phenelzine and selegiline (used to manage parkinson’s disease)
Carbamazepine (used to manage fits)
Medicines used to manage pain (Ex. pentazocine, nalbuphine, buprenorphine, morphine and codeine)
Ondansetron (used to manage nausea)
Antidepressants such as fluoxetine, escitalopram (used to manage depression)
Antipsychotics such as clozapine, amisulpride (used to manage schizophrenia disorders)
Warfarin (used to manage or manage blood clots)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of TRAMAZAC CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are excessive constriction of pupil of the eye, vomiting, sedation, seizures, coma, cardiovascular collapse and respiratory depression.

name: Tramazac 100mg Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAZAC 100MG INJECTION

TRAMAZAC 100MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TRAMAZAC 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TRAMAZAC 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRAMAZAC 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRAMAZAC 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRAMAZAC 100MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAZAC 100MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAZAC 100MG INJECTION Works

TRAMAZAC 100MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMAZAC 100MG INJECTION

TRAMAZAC 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

Before receiving TRAMAZAC 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits

It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. TRAMAZAC 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMAZAC 100MG INJECTION

name: Tapal ER 50mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET

TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET Works

TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET

Take TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET.

TYDOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE

TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE Works

TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

introduction:
Introduction About MEGA FLEXON TABLET

MEGA FLEXON TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. MEGA FLEXON TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking MEGA FLEXON TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

MEGA FLEXON TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

MEGA FLEXON TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking MEGA FLEXON TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. metoclopramide, domperidone or ondansetron)
Medicines used against infections (Ex. ketoconazole, flucloxacillin, erythromycin)
Medicine used to reduce cholesterol in the blood (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicine used in the management of depression or Parkinson’s disease (Ex. monoamine oxidase inhibitors such as phenelzine, isocarboxazid)  
Amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Medicine used to help stop smoking (Ex. bupropion)
Baclofen (used as muscle relaxant)
Warfarin, phenprocoumon (used to manage or manage blood clots)
Medicine used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine)
Morphine, buprenorphine, nalbuphine or pentazocine (used to manage severe pain)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of MEGA FLEXON TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of MEGA FLEXON TABLET includes loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, malaise, pallor, excess sweating, respiratory depression and seizures.

name: Termeg 50mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE

TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE Works

TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE

Take TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel sleepiness, blurred vision, impaired reaction and dizziness after taking TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE.
Do not consume alcohol while taking TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE as it may increase the effects of this medicine.

TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver insufficiency and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval. Consult your doctor before taking TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE.
Do not take TERMEG 50MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Introduction About TAPAL 50 TABLET

TAPAL 50 TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPAL 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPAL 50 TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPAL 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPAL 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPAL 50 TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAPAL 50 TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TAPAL 50 TABLET Works

TAPAL 50 TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPAL 50 TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Take TAPAL 50 TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAZAC P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAZAC P TABLET Works

TRAMAZAC P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

Take TRAMAZAC P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAMAZAC P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET

TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET Works

TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET

Take TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). It should be used with caution in patients having other breathing issues (slow or shallow breathing). Consult your doctor before taking TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET.

Others

TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Before taking TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

Use in paediatrics:

TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.     

 Use in geriatrics:

TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking TAPAL ER 100MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About TROMA 50 CAPSULE

TROMA 50 CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TROMA 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TROMA 50 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TROMA 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TROMA 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TROMA 50 CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TROMA 50 CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TROMA 50 CAPSULE Works

TROMA 50 CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

Take TROMA 50 CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

TROMA 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy because it may cross the placenta and its safety is not established in pregnant women. If you have severe pain, consult your doctor for advice who has to decide whether you can take single doses.

Breastfeeding

TROMA 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking TROMA 50 CAPSULE.

Driving and Using Machines

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel sleepiness, blurred vision, impaired reaction and dizziness after taking TROMA 50 CAPSULE.

Alcohol

Do not consume alcohol while taking TROMA 50 CAPSULE as it may increase the effects of this medicine.

Kidney

TROMA 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney insufficiency. It should be taken with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney insufficiency and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval. Consult your doctor before taking TROMA 50 CAPSULE.

Liver

TROMA 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver insufficiency and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval. Consult your doctor before taking TROMA 50 CAPSULE.

Allergy

Do not take TROMA 50 CAPSULE if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Lungs

TROMA 50 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with asthma or trouble breathing. Consult your doctor before taking TROMA 50 CAPSULE.

Others

TROMA 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms (due to addiction of drugs)
Have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions)

Recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick
Had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy
Have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted
Are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia)
Are addicted to morphine
Have tendency to drug addiction or abuse

TROMA 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity symptoms of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
