introduction:
Introduction About PT TABLET

PT TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. PT TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking PT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

PT TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

PT TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking PT TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PT TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How PT TABLET Works

PT TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use PT TABLET

Take PT TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take PT TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAZAC 50MG INJECTION

TRAMAZAC 50MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TRAMAZAC 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TRAMAZAC 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRAMAZAC 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRAMAZAC 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRAMAZAC 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAZAC 50MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAZAC 50MG INJECTION Works

TRAMAZAC 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMAZAC 50MG INJECTION

TRAMAZAC 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE

TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE Works

TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE

Take TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel sleepiness, blurred vision, impaired reaction and dizziness after taking TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE.
Do not consume alcohol while taking TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE as it may increase the effects of this medicine.

TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney insufficiency. It should be taken with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney insufficiency and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval. Consult your doctor before taking TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE.

TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver insufficiency and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval. Consult your doctor before taking TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE.
Do not take TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.
TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with asthma or trouble breathing. Consult your doctor before taking TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE.

Others

TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms (due to addiction of drugs)
Have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions)

Before taking TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick
Had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy
Have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted
Are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia)
Are addicted to morphine
Have tendency to drug addiction or abuse

Use in paediatrics:

TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity symptoms of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

 Use in geriatrics:

TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years) due to delayed excretion of this medicine and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval of TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE. Consult your doctor before taking TRAMAZAC 50MG CAPSULE.

name: Dolinsta Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About DOLINSTA TABLET

DOLINSTA TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and Opiate analgesics respectively. DOLINSTA TABLET is used in the management of pain and inflammation (redness and swelling). Pain is an unpleasant sensation that occurs with tissue damage. It helps the body to react and manage further tissue damage. It can be short-term (acute) or long-term (chronic) and the perception of pain can differ from one person to other.

Before taking DOLINSTA TABLET, inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gastric bleeding, severe heart failure, high blood pressure, and liver or kidney disease. DOLINSTA TABLET is not recommended in pregnant women, children and adolescents below 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking. DOLINSTA TABLET is excreted into breast milk so it not recommended in breastfeeding women, but if deemed necessary you should stop breast-feeding during the management with DOLINSTA TABLET.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DOLINSTA TABLET because it might make you dizzier. The common side effects of DOLINSTA TABLET nausea, loss of appetite, vomiting, dizziness, indigestion, sleepiness, constipation, heartburn, stomach pain and dryness in the mouth. If any of these side effects become worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: Used to manage pain and inflammation (redness and swelling)
usesDetails:

Used to manage pain and inflammation (redness and swelling)
mechanismOfAction:
How DOLINSTA TABLET Works

DOLINSTA TABLET contains Diclofenac and Tramadol. Diclofenac works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system which blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.

Take DOLINSTA TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

Introduction About TRAMACIP 50MG CAPSULE

TRAMACIP 50MG CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAMACIP 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAMACIP 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAMACIP 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMACIP 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMACIP 50MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

Uses Of TRAMACIP 50MG CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMACIP 50MG CAPSULE Works

TRAMACIP 50MG CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TAPAL 100 TABLET

TAPAL 100 TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPAL 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPAL 100 TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPAL 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPAL 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPAL 100 TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAPAL 100 TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TAPAL 100 TABLET Works

TAPAL 100 TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPAL 100 TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

introduction:
Introduction About XTRADOL 100MG TABLET

XTRADOL 100MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

name: ULTRAMED Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About ULTRAMED TABLET

ULTRAMED TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ULTRAMED TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ULTRAMED TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ULTRAMED TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ULTRAMED TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ULTRAMED TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ULTRAMED TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRAMED TABLET Works

ULTRAMED TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRAMED TABLET

Take ULTRAMED TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ULTRAMED TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About DOMADOL 50MG INJECTION

DOMADOL 50MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

DOMADOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving DOMADOL 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

DOMADOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. DOMADOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving DOMADOL 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOMADOL 50MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How DOMADOL 50MG INJECTION Works

DOMADOL 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use DOMADOL 50MG INJECTION

DOMADOL 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About ZYNTAP 50MG TABLET

ZYNTAP 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

ZYNTAP 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

ZYNTAP 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

ZYNTAP 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ZYNTAP 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking ZYNTAP 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZYNTAP 50MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How ZYNTAP 50MG TABLET Works

ZYNTAP 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. ZYNTAP 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Take ZYNTAP 50MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: TRD P Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TRD P TABLET

TRD P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRD P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRD P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRD P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRD P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRD P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRD P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRD P TABLET Works

TRD P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRD P TABLET

Take TRD P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRD P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NEWTAP 50MG TABLET

NEWTAP 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

NEWTAP 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

NEWTAP 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

NEWTAP 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. NEWTAP 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking NEWTAP 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEWTAP 50MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How NEWTAP 50MG TABLET Works

NEWTAP 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. NEWTAP 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

How to use NEWTAP 50MG TABLET

Take NEWTAP 50MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

A. Drug–Drug Interactions:

Before taking NEWTAP 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of NEWTAP 50MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAZAC 150MG TABLET

TRAMAZAC 150MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAMAZAC 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAMAZAC 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAMAZAC 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMAZAC 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMAZAC 150MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

Uses Of TRAMAZAC 150MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAZAC 150MG TABLET Works

TRAMAZAC 150MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

name: TRAZAC PLUS Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TRAZAC PLUS TABLET

TRAZAC PLUS TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAZAC PLUS TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAZAC PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAZAC PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAZAC PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAZAC PLUS TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAZAC PLUS TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAZAC PLUS TABLET Works

TRAZAC PLUS TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAZAC PLUS TABLET

Take TRAZAC PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAZAC PLUS TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOVIA 50MG TABLET

ZOVIA 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

ZOVIA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

ZOVIA 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

ZOVIA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ZOVIA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking ZOVIA 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOVIA 50MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOVIA 50MG TABLET Works

ZOVIA 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. ZOVIA 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

How to use ZOVIA 50MG TABLET

Take ZOVIA 50MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Consult with your doctor before taking ZOVIA 50MG TABLET.
ZOVIA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking ZOVIA 50MG TABLET.
Do not drive or use any machinery while taking ZOVIA 50MG TABLET if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impairment of reactions.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ZOVIA 50MG TABLET as it may increase the effect of drowsiness.

ZOVIA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking ZOVIA 50MG TABLET.

ZOVIA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. ZOVIA 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with moderate liver problems and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking ZOVIA 50MG TABLET.
Do not take ZOVIA 50MG TABLET if you are allergic to Tapentadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

ZOVIA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). It should be used with caution in patients having other breathing issues (slow or shallow breathing). Consult your doctor before taking ZOVIA 50MG TABLET.

Others

ZOVIA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Before taking ZOVIA 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

Use in paediatrics:

ZOVIA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.     

 Use in geriatrics:

ZOVIA 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking ZOVIA 50MG TABLET.

Introduction About DOLOMED T 50MG TABLET

DOLOMED T 50MG TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. DOLOMED T 50MG TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking DOLOMED T 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

DOLOMED T 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

DOLOMED T 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking DOLOMED T 50MG TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DOLOMED T 50MG TABLET Works

It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About DUOVOLT 75MG TABLET

DUOVOLT 75MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

DUOVOLT 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

DUOVOLT 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

DUOVOLT 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. DUOVOLT 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking DUOVOLT 75MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Introduction About TRAMACIP SR 100MG TABLET

TRAMACIP SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMACIP SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. How TRAMACIP SR 100MG TABLET Works

TRAMACIP SR 100MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

Introduction About TOLYDOL 50MG TABLET

TOLYDOL 50MG TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TOLYDOL 50MG TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking TOLYDOL 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TOLYDOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TOLYDOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TOLYDOL 50MG TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TOLYDOL 50MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TOLYDOL 50MG TABLET Works

TOLYDOL 50MG TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

Take TOLYDOL 50MG TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DUOVOLT 50MG TABLET

DUOVOLT 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

DUOVOLT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

DUOVOLT 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

Introduction About DOLMUNDIN 200MG TABLET

DOLMUNDIN 200MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

DOLMUNDIN 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking DOLMUNDIN 200MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

DOLMUNDIN 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. DOLMUNDIN 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking DOLMUNDIN 200MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

How DOLMUNDIN 200MG TABLET Works

DOLMUNDIN 200MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

Introduction About DOLZERO TABLET

DOLZERO TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. DOLZERO TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking DOLZERO TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

DOLZERO TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

DOLZERO TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking DOLZERO TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

Manage moderate to severe pain

Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMACIP PLUS TABLET

TRAMACIP PLUS TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAMACIP PLUS TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAMACIP PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMACIP PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMACIP PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMACIP PLUS TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMACIP PLUS TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMACIP PLUS TABLET Works

TRAMACIP PLUS TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMACIP PLUS TABLET

Take TRAMACIP PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAMACIP PLUS TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SUPRIDOL 50MG TABLET

SUPRIDOL 50MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

SUPRIDOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking SUPRIDOL 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

SUPRIDOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. SUPRIDOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking SUPRIDOL 50MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of SUPRIDOL 50MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How SUPRIDOL 50MG TABLET Works

SUPRIDOL 50MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

How to use SUPRIDOL 50MG TABLET

Take SUPRIDOL 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

SUPRIDOL 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years) due to delayed excretion of this medicine and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval of SUPRIDOL 50MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking SUPRIDOL 50MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE

PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE Works

PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE

Take PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About XTRADOL 50MG TABLET

XTRADOL 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

XTRADOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

XTRADOL 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

XTRADOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. XTRADOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking XTRADOL 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

XTRADOL 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. XTRADOL 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use XTRADOL 50MG TABLET

Take XTRADOL 50MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking XTRADOL 50MG TABLET as it may increase the effect of drowsiness.

XTRADOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking XTRADOL 50MG TABLET.

XTRADOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. XTRADOL 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with moderate liver problems and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking XTRADOL 50MG TABLET.
Do not take XTRADOL 50MG TABLET if you are allergic to Tapentadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

XTRADOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). It should be used with caution in patients having other breathing issues (slow or shallow breathing). Consult your doctor before taking XTRADOL 50MG TABLET.

Others

XTRADOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Before taking XTRADOL 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

Use in paediatrics:

XTRADOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.     

 Use in geriatrics:

XTRADOL 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking XTRADOL 50MG TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug–Drug Interactions:

Before taking XTRADOL 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Sedatives such as zolpidem, barbiturates (Ex. amobarbital, pentobarbital) antidepressants such as paroxetine, sertraline and anti-psychotics such as loxapine, clozapine, monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) such as isocarboxazid (used to manage depression, anxiety, mood disorders, sleep disturbances) 
Opioids such as codeine, oxymorphone, mixed mu-opioid agonist/antagonists such as pentazocine, nalbuphine, partial mu-opioid agonists such as buprenorphine (used to manage severe pain)
Antihistamines such as cetirizine, loratadine (used to manage allergy)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
St. john’s wort (herbal medicine used to manage depression)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of XTRADOL 50MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of XTRADOL 50MG TABLET are pin-point pupils, vomiting, fast heartbeat, drop in blood pressure, collapse, disturbed consciousness or coma (deep unconsciousness), epileptic fits (convulsions), dangerously slow or shallow breathing or stopping breathing may occur.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION

TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION Works

TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION

TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

Before receiving TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION to your child. 

Use in geriatrics:

TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMAZAC 50 INJECTION

introduction:
Introduction About BETAREST 50MG TABLET

BETAREST 50MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

BETAREST 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking BETAREST 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

BETAREST 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. BETAREST 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking BETAREST 50MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel sleepiness, blurred vision, impaired reaction and dizziness after taking BETAREST 50MG TABLET.
Do not consume alcohol while taking BETAREST 50MG TABLET as it may increase the effects of this medicine.

BETAREST 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney insufficiency. It should be taken with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney insufficiency and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval. Consult your doctor before taking BETAREST 50MG TABLET.

BETAREST 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver insufficiency and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval. Consult your doctor before taking BETAREST 50MG TABLET.
Do not take BETAREST 50MG TABLET if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.
BETAREST 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma or trouble breathing. Consult your doctor before taking BETAREST 50MG TABLET.

Others

BETAREST 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms (due to addiction of drugs)
Have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions)

Before taking BETAREST 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick
Had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy
Have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted
Are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia)
Are addicted to morphine
Have tendency to drug addiction or abuse

Use in paediatrics:

BETAREST 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity symptoms of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

 Use in geriatrics:

BETAREST 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years) due to delayed excretion of this medicine and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval of BETAREST 50MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking BETAREST 50MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOVIA 75MG TABLET

ZOVIA 75MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

ZOVIA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

ZOVIA 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

ZOVIA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ZOVIA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking ZOVIA 75MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOVIA 75MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOVIA 75MG TABLET Works

ZOVIA 75MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. ZOVIA 75MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use ZOVIA 75MG TABLET

Take ZOVIA 75MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug–Drug Interactions:

Before taking ZOVIA 75MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Sedatives such as zolpidem, barbiturates (Ex. amobarbital, pentobarbital) antidepressants such as paroxetine, sertraline and anti-psychotics such as loxapine, clozapine, monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) such as isocarboxazid (used to manage depression, anxiety, mood disorders, sleep disturbances) 
Opioids such as codeine, oxymorphone, mixed mu-opioid agonist/antagonists such as pentazocine, nalbuphine, partial mu-opioid agonists such as buprenorphine (used to manage severe pain)
Antihistamines such as cetirizine, loratadine (used to manage allergy)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
St. john’s wort (herbal medicine used to manage depression)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of ZOVIA 75MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of ZOVIA 75MG TABLET are pin-point pupils, vomiting, fast heartbeat, drop in blood pressure, collapse, disturbed consciousness or coma (deep unconsciousness), epileptic fits (convulsions), dangerously slow or shallow breathing or stopping breathing may occur.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAZAC SR 100MG TABLET

TRAMAZAC SR 100MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAMAZAC SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAMAZAC SR 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAMAZAC SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMAZAC SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMAZAC SR 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

Uses Of TRAMAZAC SR 100MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAZAC SR 100MG TABLET Works

TRAMAZAC SR 100MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

name: IVACET Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About IVACET TABLET

IVACET TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. IVACET TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking IVACET TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

IVACET TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

IVACET TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking IVACET TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of IVACET TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How IVACET TABLET Works

IVACET TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use IVACET TABLET

Take IVACET TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take IVACET TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About DOMADOL 100MG INJECTION

DOMADOL 100MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

DOMADOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving DOMADOL 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

DOMADOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. DOMADOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving DOMADOL 100MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOMADOL 100MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How DOMADOL 100MG INJECTION Works

DOMADOL 100MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use DOMADOL 100MG INJECTION

DOMADOL 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
