Introduction About DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET

DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET Works

DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET

Take DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor as it can cause withdrawal symptoms in the new-born baby when used for prolonged period of time, which might be life threatening and could also possibly lead to dangerously slow or shallow breathing in the newborn. Consult with your doctor before taking DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET.
DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET.
Do not drive or use any machinery while taking DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impairment of reactions.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET as it may increase the effect of drowsiness.

DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET.

DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with moderate liver problems and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET.
Do not take DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET if you are allergic to Tapentadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). It should be used with caution in patients having other breathing issues (slow or shallow breathing). Consult your doctor before taking DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET.

Others

DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Before taking DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

Use in paediatrics:

DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.     

 Use in geriatrics:

DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug–Drug Interactions:

Before taking DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Sedatives such as zolpidem, barbiturates (Ex. amobarbital, pentobarbital) antidepressants such as paroxetine, sertraline and anti-psychotics such as loxapine, clozapine, monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) such as isocarboxazid (used to manage depression, anxiety, mood disorders, sleep disturbances) 
Opioids such as codeine, oxymorphone, mixed mu-opioid agonist/antagonists such as pentazocine, nalbuphine, partial mu-opioid agonists such as buprenorphine (used to manage severe pain)
Antihistamines such as cetirizine, loratadine (used to manage allergy)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
St. john’s wort (herbal medicine used to manage depression)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of DUOVOLT ER 50MG TABLET are pin-point pupils, vomiting, fast heartbeat, drop in blood pressure, collapse, disturbed consciousness or coma (deep unconsciousness), epileptic fits (convulsions), dangerously slow or shallow breathing or stopping breathing may occur.

name: Ultramol Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ULTRAMOL TABLET

ULTRAMOL TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ULTRAMOL TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking ULTRAMOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ULTRAMOL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ULTRAMOL TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ULTRAMOL TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ULTRAMOL TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRAMOL TABLET Works

ULTRAMOL TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRAMOL TABLET

Take ULTRAMOL TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ULTRAMOL TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: ULTRAMOL TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
ULTRAMOL TABLET is not recommended for use during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel drowsy after taking ULTRAMOL TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ULTRAMOL TABLET because it might make you feel drowsy and it is not recommended for use in patients with acute alcohol poisoning.
ULTRAMOL TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking ULTRAMOL TABLET.

ULTRAMOL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with the severe liver disorders and should be used with caution in patients with liver problems or jaundice. Consult your doctor before taking ULTRAMOL TABLET.
Do not take ULTRAMOL TABLET if you are allergic to Paracetamol, Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.
ULTRAMOL TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have severe difficulties in breathing like asthma or severe lung problems. Consult your doctor before taking ULTRAMOL TABLET.

Others

Have epilepsy (which is not adequately controlled by your current medicine)
Known or suspected gastrointestinal obstruction including paralytic ileus

Have epilepsy or already experienced fits or seizures
Have recently suffered from a head injury, shock or severe headaches associated with vomiting
Have an intolerance to certain sugars
Have depression

Use in geriatrics:

ULTRAMOL TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Codine Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About CODINE TABLET

CODINE TABLET contains Codeine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used to provide relief from cough and pain. It can also be used to manage the symptoms of persistent diarrhea.

Before taking CODINE TABLET inform your doctor if you have any previous history of drug abuse, addiction or developed withdrawal symptoms after stopping an opioid medication.

You must also inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, kidney problems, low blood pressure, breathing difficulties (Ex. asthma), bowel inflammation, fits, any mental illnesses, muscle problems, thyroid problems, or any surgery in the gut or urinary tract as a precaution.

Take CODINE TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Do not overuse or misuse this medicine as it may make you feel getting addicted to it. While undergoing therapy with CODINE TABLET, inform your doctor if you suddenly couldn’t notice any improvement in your condition. This is because, your body might have become tolerant to this medicine, and you may need a higher dose to see the desired result.

Do not take CODINE TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking CODINE TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, tiredness, mood changes, nightmares, restlessness, constipation, dry mouth, constricted pupils, fast heart rate and decrease in sex drive. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

Manages the symptoms of persistent diarrhea

mechanismOfAction:
How CODINE TABLET Works

CODINE TABLET is an opioid medication. It works by changing the way your brain responds to pain. It interrupts the transmission of pain signals between the affected regions and the brain. It reduces cough by suppressing the activity of certain parts of the brain that triggers cough reflexes.
usageDetails:
How to use CODINE TABLET

Take CODINE TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not take this medicine for more than 3 days continuously without consulting your doctor.

warnings.details: CODINE TABLET should not be used in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Your doctor will prescribe this medicine after evaluating the benefits of the therapy to the mother and the potential risks to the foetus. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
CODINE TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it should not be used in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.

CODINE TABLET may cause drowsiness, hallucination, blurred vision, confusion, fits or dizziness. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by CODINE TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAZA 50 TABLET

TRAZA 50 TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAZA 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAZA 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAZA 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAZA 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAZA 50 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAZA 50 TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAZA 50 TABLET Works

TRAZA 50 TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAZA 50 TABLET

Take TRAZA 50 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Norphin Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NORPHIN

NORPHIN contains Buprenorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioid Analgesics. It is used to provide relief from moderate or severe pain in affected individuals.     

Pain is an uncomfortable sensation in the body that stems from the activation of nervous system which generally occurs as an annoying or debilitating sensation characterized by symptoms such as sharp, dull, throbbing, pinching, stinging, and/or burning sensation in affected individuals.    

It is not recommended for use if you are allergic to buprenorphine or other opiates (having morphine-like action). Before taking NORPHIN, inform your doctor if you have breathing problems, liver problems, renal impairment, seizures (fits) and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).     

Opioids can lead to addiction, particularly when used for a long period of time and it may cause withdrawal symptoms (such as restlessness, difficulty sleeping, irritability, agitation, palpitation, etc.) when stop taking this medicine suddenly.        

NORPHIN is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, including infants and children (under 6 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking NORPHIN.       

The common side effects associated with the use of NORPHIN are constipation, headache, nausea, urinary retention and sedation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAGLOBE P TABLET

TRAMAGLOBE P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAMAGLOBE P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAMAGLOBE P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMAGLOBE P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMAGLOBE P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMAGLOBE P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAGLOBE P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAGLOBE P TABLET Works

TRAMAGLOBE P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMAGLOBE P TABLET

Take TRAMAGLOBE P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAMAGLOBE P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET

TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET Works

TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Others

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Before taking TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking TAPAL ER 50MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAGEM P TABLET

TRAGEM P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAGEM P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAGEM P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAGEM P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAGEM P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAGEM P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAGEM P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAGEM P TABLET Works

TRAGEM P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAGEM P TABLET

Take TRAGEM P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAGEM P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAGOLD TABLET

TRAMAGOLD TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAMAGOLD TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking TRAMAGOLD TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMAGOLD TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMAGOLD TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMAGOLD TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAGOLD TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAGOLD TABLET Works

TRAMAGOLD TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

Take TRAMAGOLD TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAMAGOLD TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TAPFREE ER 100 TABLET

TAPFREE ER 100 TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPFREE ER 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPFREE ER 100 TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPFREE ER 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPFREE ER 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPFREE ER 100 TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAPFREE ER 100 TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TAPFREE ER 100 TABLET Works

TAPFREE ER 100 TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPFREE ER 100 TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

introduction:
Introduction About TERMEG 50MG INJECTION

TERMEG 50MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TERMEG 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TERMEG 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TERMEG 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TERMEG 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TERMEG 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERMEG 50MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TERMEG 50MG INJECTION Works

TERMEG 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TERMEG 50MG INJECTION

TERMEG 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: TERMEG 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women planning to have a baby because the baby may become dependent and may show withdrawal symptoms after the birth. Consult your doctor before receiving TERMEG 50MG INJECTION.
TERMEG 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and will affect the baby. Consult your doctor before receiving TERMEG 50MG INJECTION.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impaired reaction after receiving TERMEG 50MG INJECTION.
Do not consume alcohol while receiving TERMEG 50MG INJECTION as it may increase the effects of this medicine.
TERMEG 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TERMEG 50MG INJECTION.
TERMEG 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TERMEG 50MG INJECTION.
Do not receive TERMEG 50MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

TERMEG 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

Before receiving TERMEG 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

TERMEG 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of TERMEG 50MG INJECTION to your child. 

Use in geriatrics:

TERMEG 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving TERMEG 50MG INJECTION

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before receiving TERMEG 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:  

Benzodiazepines (medicines used to manage anxiety or sleep problems) Ex. diazepam, lorazepam
Anticoagulants (medicines used to manage or manage blood clots) Ex. warfarin
Carbamazepine (used to manage fits)
Ondansetron (used to manage or manage nausea)
Monoamine oxidase inhibitors (medicines used to manage depression) Ex. moclobemide, phenelzine and selegiline (used to manage Parkinson's disease)
Other medicines used to manage pain (Ex. pentazocine, buprenorphine, morphine, codeine)                     

Overdosage:

TERMEG 50MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a physician or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your physician if you experience any unusual symptoms. Overdosage symptoms of TERMEG 50MG INJECTION are excessive constriction of the pupil of the eye, vomiting, cardiovascular collapse, consciousness disorders up to coma, convulsions, respiratory depression up to respiratory arrest and serotonin syndrome (a serious drug reaction).

name: Tapenax ER 50mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET

TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET Works

TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET

Take TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor as it can cause withdrawal symptoms in the new-born baby when used for prolonged period of time, which might be life threatening and could also possibly lead to dangerously slow or shallow breathing in the newborn. Consult with your doctor before taking TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET.
TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET.
Do not drive or use any machinery while taking TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impairment of reactions.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET as it may increase the effect of drowsiness.

TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET.

TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with moderate liver problems and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET.
Do not take TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET if you are allergic to Tapentadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). It should be used with caution in patients having other breathing issues (slow or shallow breathing). Consult your doctor before taking TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET.

Others

TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Before taking TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

Use in paediatrics:

TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.     

 Use in geriatrics:

TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug–Drug Interactions:

Before taking TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Sedatives such as zolpidem, barbiturates (Ex. amobarbital, pentobarbital) antidepressants such as paroxetine, sertraline and anti-psychotics such as loxapine, clozapine, monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) such as isocarboxazid (used to manage depression, anxiety, mood disorders, sleep disturbances) 
Opioids such as codeine, oxymorphone, mixed mu-opioid agonist/antagonists such as pentazocine, nalbuphine, partial mu-opioid agonists such as buprenorphine (used to manage severe pain)
Antihistamines such as cetirizine, loratadine (used to manage allergy)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
St. john’s wort (herbal medicine used to manage depression)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of TAPENAX ER 50MG TABLET are pin-point pupils, vomiting, fast heartbeat, drop in blood pressure, collapse, disturbed consciousness or coma (deep unconsciousness), epileptic fits (convulsions), dangerously slow or shallow breathing or stopping breathing may occur.

name: ULTRIN Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ULTRIN TABLET

ULTRIN TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ULTRIN TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ULTRIN TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ULTRIN TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ULTRIN TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ULTRIN TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ULTRIN TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRIN TABLET Works

ULTRIN TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRIN TABLET

Take ULTRIN TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ULTRIN TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAZAC TC 100MG TABLET

TRAMAZAC TC 100MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAMAZAC TC 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAMAZAC TC 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAMAZAC TC 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMAZAC TC 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMAZAC TC 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAZAC TC 100MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAZAC TC 100MG TABLET Works

TRAMAZAC TC 100MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMAZAC TC 100MG TABLET

Take TRAMAZAC TC 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CODEINE SULPHATE TABLET

CODEINE SULPHATE TABLET contains Codeine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used to provide relief from cough and pain. It can also be used to manage the symptoms of persistent diarrhea.

Before taking CODEINE SULPHATE TABLET inform your doctor if you have any previous history of drug abuse, addiction or developed withdrawal symptoms after stopping an opioid medication.

You must also inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, kidney problems, low blood pressure, breathing difficulties (Ex. asthma), bowel inflammation, fits, any mental illnesses, muscle problems, thyroid problems, or any surgery in the gut or urinary tract as a precaution.

Take CODEINE SULPHATE TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Do not overuse or misuse this medicine as it may make you feel getting addicted to it. While undergoing therapy with CODEINE SULPHATE TABLET, inform your doctor if you suddenly couldn’t notice any improvement in your condition. This is because, your body might have become tolerant to this medicine, and you may need a higher dose to see the desired result.

Do not take CODEINE SULPHATE TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking CODEINE SULPHATE TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, tiredness, mood changes, nightmares, restlessness, constipation, dry mouth, constricted pupils, fast heart rate and decrease in sex drive. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMEF P TABLET TABLET

TRAMEF P TABLET TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAMEF P TABLET TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAMEF P TABLET TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMEF P TABLET TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMEF P TABLET TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMEF P TABLET TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMEF P TABLET TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMEF P TABLET TABLET Works

TRAMEF P TABLET TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMEF P TABLET TABLET

Take TRAMEF P TABLET TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAMEF P TABLET TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Esgipyrin T 325/37.5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET

ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET Works

ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET

Take ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. metoclopramide, domperidone or ondansetron)
Medicines used against infections (Ex. ketoconazole, flucloxacillin, erythromycin)
Medicine used to reduce cholesterol in the blood (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicine used in the management of depression or Parkinson’s disease (Ex. monoamine oxidase inhibitors such as phenelzine, isocarboxazid)  
Amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Medicine used to help stop smoking (Ex. bupropion)
Baclofen (used as muscle relaxant)
Warfarin, phenprocoumon (used to manage or manage blood clots)
Medicine used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine)
Morphine, buprenorphine, nalbuphine or pentazocine (used to manage severe pain)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of ESGIPYRIN T 325/37.5MG TABLET includes loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, malaise, pallor, excess sweating, respiratory depression and seizures.

name: Termeg 50mg Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About TERMEG 50MG INJECTION

TERMEG 50MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TERMEG 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TERMEG 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TERMEG 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TERMEG 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TERMEG 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TERMEG 50MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TERMEG 50MG INJECTION Works

TERMEG 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TERMEG 50MG INJECTION

TERMEG 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About VICTADOL TABLET

VICTADOL TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

VICTADOL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking VICTADOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

VICTADOL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. VICTADOL TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking VICTADOL TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of VICTADOL TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How VICTADOL TABLET Works

VICTADOL TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use VICTADOL TABLET

Take VICTADOL TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About INTAP 50MG TABLET

INTAP 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

INTAP 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

INTAP 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

INTAP 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. INTAP 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking INTAP 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How INTAP 50MG TABLET Works

INTAP 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. INTAP 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAD 50 CAPSULE Works

TRAMAD 50 CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

introduction:
Introduction About TRABEST TABLET

TRABEST TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRABEST TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking TRABEST TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRABEST TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRABEST TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRABEST TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRABEST TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRABEST TABLET Works

TRABEST TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRABEST TABLET

Take TRABEST TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRABEST TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ZUPRINOR 5 TRANSDERMAL PATCH

ZUPRINOR 5 TRANSDERMAL PATCH contains Buprenorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Strong analgesics. It is used to provide relief from moderate long-lasting pain that requires the use of a strong painkiller in affected individuals.

Pain is an uncomfortable sensation in the body that stems from the activation of nervous system which generally occurs as an annoying or debilitating sensation generally characterized by symptoms such as as a sharp, dull, throbbing, pinching, stinging and/or burning sensation in affected individuals.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while using ZUPRINOR 5 TRANSDERMAL PATCH. This medicine is not recommended for use in patients with breathing problems, addiction to drugs and/or myasthenia gravis (condition that weakness muscles). Before using [GNKEYWORD], inform your doctor if you suffer from sleep apnoea (a breathing related sleep disorder), severe liver problems and/or kidney diseases.

ZUPRINOR 5 TRANSDERMAL PATCH is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

The most common side effects associated with the use of ZUPRINOR 5 TRANSDERMAL PATCH are headache, dizziness, drowsiness, constipation, nausea, vomiting and itchy skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Provides relief from moderate long-lasting pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZUPRINOR 5 TRANSDERMAL PATCH
Provides relief from moderate long-lasting pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ZUPRINOR 5 TRANSDERMAL PATCH Works

ZUPRINOR 5 TRANSDERMAL PATCH works by blocking certain receptors (responsible for pain) in the brain and spinal cord which leads to blockade of pain transmission thus providing relief from moderate and long-lasting pain in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use ZUPRINOR 5 TRANSDERMAL PATCH

Use ZUPRINOR 5 TRANSDERMAL PATCH as advised by your physician. Wash and dry the area where the transdermal patch must be placed. Choose a non-irritated, intact skin, relatively hairless or nearly hairless skin area on your upper arm, outer arm, upper chest, upper back, or side of the chest to apply the patch. The sticky side of the patch is protected with a silvery protective foil which is carefully removed without touching the sticky part of the patch. Stick the patch on to the chosen area of the skin and remove the foil.

Press the patch against the skin with your palm and count to 30 seconds slowly. Ensure, the whole patch is in contact with your skin, especially at the edges. The patch should be worn for seven days. Avoid exposing the patch to extreme heat. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About CONTRAMAL 50MG CAPSULE

CONTRAMAL 50MG CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

CONTRAMAL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking CONTRAMAL 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

CONTRAMAL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. CONTRAMAL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking CONTRAMAL 50MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CONTRAMAL 50MG CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How CONTRAMAL 50MG CAPSULE Works

CONTRAMAL 50MG CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

Take CONTRAMAL 50MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION Works

ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION

ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not receive ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

Before receiving ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION to your child. 

Use in geriatrics:

ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before receiving ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:  

Benzodiazepines (medicines used to manage anxiety or sleep problems) Ex. diazepam, lorazepam
Anticoagulants (medicines used to manage or manage blood clots) Ex. warfarin
Carbamazepine (used to manage fits)
Ondansetron (used to manage or manage nausea)
Monoamine oxidase inhibitors (medicines used to manage depression) Ex. moclobemide, phenelzine and selegiline (used to manage Parkinson's disease)
Other medicines used to manage pain (Ex. pentazocine, buprenorphine, morphine, codeine)                     

Overdosage:

ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a physician or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your physician if you experience any unusual symptoms. Overdosage symptoms of ULTRAMOL 50MG INJECTION are excessive constriction of the pupil of the eye, vomiting, cardiovascular collapse, consciousness disorders up to coma, convulsions, respiratory depression up to respiratory arrest and serotonin syndrome (a serious drug reaction).

Introduction About ZOFTADOL 50MG CAPSULE

ZOFTADOL 50MG CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

ZOFTADOL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking ZOFTADOL 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

ZOFTADOL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. ZOFTADOL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking ZOFTADOL 50MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About PATRADOL TABLET

PATRADOL TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. PATRADOL TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking PATRADOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

PATRADOL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

PATRADOL TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking PATRADOL TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PATRADOL TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How PATRADOL TABLET Works

PATRADOL TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use PATRADOL TABLET

Take PATRADOL TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take PATRADOL TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CODIN 30 TABLET

CODIN 30 TABLET contains Codeine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used to provide relief from cough and pain. It can also be used to manage the symptoms of persistent diarrhea.

Before taking CODIN 30 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any previous history of drug abuse, addiction or developed withdrawal symptoms after stopping an opioid medication.

You must also inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, kidney problems, low blood pressure, breathing difficulties (Ex. asthma), bowel inflammation, fits, any mental illnesses, muscle problems, thyroid problems, or any surgery in the gut or urinary tract as a precaution.

Take CODIN 30 TABLET only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Do not overuse or misuse this medicine as it may make you feel getting addicted to it. While undergoing therapy with CODIN 30 TABLET, inform your doctor if you suddenly couldn’t notice any improvement in your condition. This is because, your body might have become tolerant to this medicine, and you may need a higher dose to see the desired result.

Do not take CODIN 30 TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking CODIN 30 TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, tiredness, mood changes, nightmares, restlessness, constipation, dry mouth, constricted pupils, fast heart rate and decrease in sex drive. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

Manages the symptoms of persistent diarrhea
