mechanismOfAction:
How CODIN 30 TABLET Works

CODIN 30 TABLET is an opioid medication. It works by changing the way your brain responds to pain. It interrupts the transmission of pain signals between the affected regions and the brain. It reduces cough by suppressing the activity of certain parts of the brain that triggers cough reflexes.
usageDetails:
How to use CODIN 30 TABLET

Take CODIN 30 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not take this medicine for more than 3 days continuously without consulting your doctor.

warnings.details: CODIN 30 TABLET should not be used in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Your doctor will prescribe this medicine after evaluating the benefits of the therapy to the mother and the potential risks to the foetus. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
CODIN 30 TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it should not be used in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.

CODIN 30 TABLET may cause drowsiness, hallucination, blurred vision, confusion, fits or dizziness. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by CODIN 30 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CODIN 30 TABLET as it might make you feel sleepy.
CODIN 30 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

CODIN 30 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver failure. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems, gall stones or gall bladder problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take CODIN 30 TABLET if you are allergic to Codeine.
CODIN 30 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with chronic lung disease, breathing problems or an active asthma attack. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
CODIN 30 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with an irregular heartbeat or low blood pressure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

CODIN 30 TABLET can be used in children and adolescents (aged 12 years or above) if prescribed by the physician. It is not recommended for use in children aged below 12 years. It is also not suitable for use in children with compromised respiratory function and in children who have undergone removal of tonsils or adenoids. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
CODIN 30 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

CODIN 30 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Suffered a head injury or raised pressure in the skull (symptoms include painful eyes, vision changes, headache behind the eyes)
Drink a lot of alcohol (alcoholism)
Suffer from diarrhea associated with severe bowel inflammation
Are at risk of having a blockage in your intestines

Before taking CODIN 30 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have a history of drug abuse (opioids, alcohol, etc.)
Previously suffered withdrawal symptoms (such as anxiety, agitation, shaking or sweating) after stopping the use of opioid medicines
Have any mental illnesses
Have fits
Have recently undergone any surgery in your gut or in urinary system
Are in shock (sudden loss of blood circulation)
Have thyroid dysfunction
Have an enlarged prostate
Have any acute stomach conditions or inflammations that can cause bloody diarrhea
Suffer from severe muscle weakness
Have problems with your adrenal glands (such as Addison’s disease)
Have phaeochromocytoma (tumour on top of adrenal glands)

introduction:
Introduction About VORTH TM TABLET

VORTH TM TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. VORTH TM TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking VORTH TM TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

VORTH TM TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

VORTH TM TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking VORTH TM TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of VORTH TM TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How VORTH TM TABLET Works

VORTH TM TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use VORTH TM TABLET

Take VORTH TM TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take VORTH TM TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAMASURE PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMASURE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMASURE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMASURE PLUS TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMASURE PLUS TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMASURE PLUS TABLET Works

TRAMASURE PLUS TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMASURE PLUS TABLET

Take TRAMASURE PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAMASURE PLUS TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of TRAMASURE PLUS TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of TRAMASURE PLUS TABLET includes loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, malaise, pallor, excess sweating, respiratory depression and seizures.

name: Addnok Tablet 20'S
introduction:
Introduction About ADDNOK TABLET

ADDNOK TABLET contains Buprenorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioid Analgesics. It is used to provide relief from moderate or severe pain in affected individuals.     

Pain is an uncomfortable sensation in the body that stems from the activation of nervous system which generally occurs as an annoying or debilitating sensation characterized by symptoms such as sharp, dull, throbbing, pinching, stinging, and/or burning sensation in affected individuals.    

It is not recommended for use if you are allergic to buprenorphine or other opiates (having morphine-like action). Before taking ADDNOK TABLET, inform your doctor if you have breathing problems, liver problems, renal impairment, seizures (fits) and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).     

Opioids can lead to addiction, particularly when used for a long period of time and it may cause withdrawal symptoms (such as restlessness, difficulty sleeping, irritability, agitation, palpitation, etc.) when stop taking this medicine suddenly.        

ADDNOK TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, including infants and children (under 6 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking ADDNOK TABLET.       

The common side effects associated with the use of ADDNOK TABLET are constipation, headache, nausea, urinary retention and sedation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How ADDNOK TABLET Works

ADDNOK TABLET works by blocking certain receptors (responsible for pain) in the brain and spinal cord which leads to blockage of pain transmission thus providing relief from moderate/severe pain in affected individuals.

Take ADDNOK TABLET as advised by your physician. Place the medicine beneath the tongue and let it dissolve. Do not crush, chew or swallow the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not take more ADDNOK TABLET without the advice of your doctor.

ADDNOK TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it passes through breast milk. Consult your doctor taking ADDNOK TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel drowsy, sleepy or dizzy after taking ADDNOK TABLET.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ADDNOK TABLET because it may cause drowsiness. It should be used with caution in patients with a history of alcohol withdrawal symptoms (such as agitation, anxiety, shaking, and/or sweating) and also in patients who are addicted to alcohol. Consult doctor before taking ADDNOK TABLET.
ADDNOK TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking ADDNOK TABLET.
Do not take ADDNOK TABLET if you are allergic to Buprenorphine, other opiates (having morphine like action) or any other ingredients of this medicine. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
ADDNOK TABLET should be used with caution in patients with breathing problems. Consult your doctor before taking ADDNOK TABLET.

Others

Before taking ADDNOK TABLET, inform your doctor if you:    

Have seizures, fits or convulsions
Are or were addicted to opioids, prescription medicines or illegal drugs
Require more medicine to get the same level of pain relief or get addicted to the medicine
Have depression or other conditions that are managed with antidepressants
Are intolerant to certain sugars (such as lactose)

Use in pediatrics:

ADDNOK TABLET is not recommended for use in infants and children (below 6 years of age). Your child’s doctor will prescribe the right dose depending on your child’s age, body weight and condition (between 6 to 12 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.   

Use in geriatrics:

ADDNOK TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking ADDNOK TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About KAMADOL 50 INJECTION

KAMADOL 50 INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

KAMADOL 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving KAMADOL 50 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

KAMADOL 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. KAMADOL 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving KAMADOL 50 INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KAMADOL 50 INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How KAMADOL 50 INJECTION Works

KAMADOL 50 INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use KAMADOL 50 INJECTION

KAMADOL 50 INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CALPOL T 325/37.5MG TABLET

CALPOL T 325/37.5MG TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. CALPOL T 325/37.5MG TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking CALPOL T 325/37.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

CALPOL T 325/37.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

CALPOL T 325/37.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking CALPOL T 325/37.5MG TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CALPOL T 325/37.5MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How CALPOL T 325/37.5MG TABLET Works

CALPOL T 325/37.5MG TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use CALPOL T 325/37.5MG TABLET

Take CALPOL T 325/37.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take CALPOL T 325/37.5MG TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ZYNTAP 100MG TABLET

ZYNTAP 100MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

ZYNTAP 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

ZYNTAP 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

ZYNTAP 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ZYNTAP 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking ZYNTAP 100MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZYNTAP 100MG TABLET Works

ZYNTAP 100MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. ZYNTAP 100MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

introduction:
Introduction About SUPRIDOL 100MG SUPPOSITORY

SUPRIDOL 100MG SUPPOSITORY contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioid analgesics. It is indicated to manage moderate to severe pain. Pain is an uncomfortable sensory and emotional experience associated with or resembling actual or potential tissue damage. It is always a personal experience that depends on various biological, psychological and social factors.

Your doctor will manage you with SUPRIDOL 100MG SUPPOSITORY for short periods with regular breaks to minimise the risk of developing dependence.

SUPRIDOL 100MG SUPPOSITORY is not recommended for use in patients having epilepsy (fits) which is not controlled with management, in acute poisoning with medicines that affect mood and emotions and as a substitute in the management of drug withdrawal.

Before using SUPRIDOL 100MG SUPPOSITORY, inform your doctor if you have a head injury, breathing difficulties, any consciousness disorders, severe kidney and liver problems or addiction to any painkillers.

SUPRIDOL 100MG SUPPOSITORY should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it necessary and it is not recommended for use in breast feeding mothers more than once. SUPRIDOL 100MG SUPPOSITORY is not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age and those with breathing problems. SUPRIDOL 100MG SUPPOSITORY should be used with caution among elderly people.

The most common side effects of using SUPRIDOL 100MG SUPPOSITORY are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, constipation and sweating. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects deteriorate.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SUPRIDOL 100MG SUPPOSITORY
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How SUPRIDOL 100MG SUPPOSITORY Works

SUPRIDOL 100MG SUPPOSITORY inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use SUPRIDOL 100MG SUPPOSITORY

Always use SUPRIDOL 100MG SUPPOSITORY as directed by the physician. It is for rectal use only. It must be inserted deep into the back passage (rectum) as directed by your doctor. For easy insertion, you can either warm the medicine up in your hands or briefly dip it in hot water. Your doctor will give an appropriate dose of SUPRIDOL 100MG SUPPOSITORY depending on your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

Introduction About TRENTADOL 100 TABLET

TRENTADOL 100 TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TRENTADOL 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TRENTADOL 100 TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TRENTADOL 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TRENTADOL 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TRENTADOL 100 TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

TRENTADOL 100 TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. introduction:
Introduction About XYROCET TABLET

XYROCET TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. XYROCET TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking XYROCET TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

XYROCET TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

XYROCET TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking XYROCET TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of XYROCET TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How XYROCET TABLET Works

XYROCET TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use XYROCET TABLET

Take XYROCET TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take XYROCET TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

TRAMAZAC OD 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMAZAC OD 200MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About BKDOL T TABLET

BKDOL T TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

BKDOL T TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

BKDOL T TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

BKDOL T TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. BKDOL T TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking BKDOL T TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

usesDetails:
Uses Of BKDOL T TABLET

mechanismOfAction:
How BKDOL T TABLET Works

BKDOL T TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. BKDOL T TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Take BKDOL T TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRSON P TABLET

TRSON P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRSON P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRSON P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRSON P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRSON P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRSON P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRSON P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRSON P TABLET Works

TRSON P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRSON P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Calpol T Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About CALPOL T TABLET

CALPOL T TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. CALPOL T TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking CALPOL T TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

CALPOL T TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

CALPOL T TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking CALPOL T TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CALPOL T TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How CALPOL T TABLET Works

CALPOL T TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use CALPOL T TABLET

Take CALPOL T TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take CALPOL T TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About REVODOL 50MG TABLET

REVODOL 50MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

REVODOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking REVODOL 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

REVODOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. REVODOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking REVODOL 50MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of REVODOL 50MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How REVODOL 50MG TABLET Works

REVODOL 50MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

introduction:
Introduction About TYDOL 75MG TABLET

TYDOL 75MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TYDOL 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TYDOL 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TYDOL 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TYDOL 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TYDOL 75MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About PALITEX FLASH TABLET

PALITEX FLASH TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. PALITEX FLASH TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking PALITEX FLASH TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

PALITEX FLASH TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

PALITEX FLASH TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking PALITEX FLASH TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PALITEX FLASH TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How PALITEX FLASH TABLET Works

PALITEX FLASH TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use PALITEX FLASH TABLET

Take PALITEX FLASH TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take PALITEX FLASH TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About CG MAC 50 TABLET

CG MAC 50 TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

CG MAC 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking CG MAC 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

CG MAC 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. CG MAC 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking CG MAC 50 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

CG MAC 50 TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

introduction:
Introduction About NEUTRAM 50MG CAPSULE

NEUTRAM 50MG CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

NEUTRAM 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking NEUTRAM 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

NEUTRAM 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. NEUTRAM 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking NEUTRAM 50MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEUTRAM 50MG CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How NEUTRAM 50MG CAPSULE Works

NEUTRAM 50MG CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use NEUTRAM 50MG CAPSULE

Take NEUTRAM 50MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About IMEDOL TABLET

IMEDOL TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and Opiate analgesics respectively. IMEDOL TABLET is used in the management of pain and inflammation (redness and swelling). Pain is an unpleasant sensation that occurs with tissue damage. It helps the body to react and manage further tissue damage. It can be short-term (acute) or long-term (chronic) and the perception of pain can differ from one person to other.

Before taking IMEDOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gastric bleeding, severe heart failure, high blood pressure, and liver or kidney disease. IMEDOL TABLET is not recommended in pregnant women, children and adolescents below 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking. IMEDOL TABLET is excreted into breast milk so it not recommended in breastfeeding women, but if deemed necessary you should stop breast-feeding during the management with IMEDOL TABLET.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking IMEDOL TABLET because it might make you dizzier. The common side effects of IMEDOL TABLET nausea, loss of appetite, vomiting, dizziness, indigestion, sleepiness, constipation, heartburn, stomach pain and dryness in the mouth. If any of these side effects become worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: Used to manage pain and inflammation (redness and swelling)

Used to manage pain and inflammation (redness and swelling)
mechanismOfAction:
How IMEDOL TABLET Works

IMEDOL TABLET contains Diclofenac and Tramadol. Diclofenac works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system which blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.

introduction:
Introduction About TAPFREE MONO 100MG TABLET

TAPFREE MONO 100MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPFREE MONO 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPFREE MONO 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPFREE MONO 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPFREE MONO 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPFREE MONO 100MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TAPFREE MONO 100MG TABLET Works

TAPFREE MONO 100MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPFREE MONO 100MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits

name: ULTRIN D Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ULTRIN D TABLET

ULTRIN D TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ULTRIN D TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ULTRIN D TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ULTRIN D TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ULTRIN D TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ULTRIN D TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ULTRIN D TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRIN D TABLET Works

ULTRIN D TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRIN D TABLET

Take ULTRIN D TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ULTRIN D TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About DOLMUNDIN 100MG TABLET

DOLMUNDIN 100MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

DOLMUNDIN 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking DOLMUNDIN 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

DOLMUNDIN 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. DOLMUNDIN 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking DOLMUNDIN 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About TORMADOL PLUS TABLET

TORMADOL PLUS TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TORMADOL PLUS TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Introduction About BESTODOL 50 INJECTION

BESTODOL 50 INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

BESTODOL 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving BESTODOL 50 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

BESTODOL 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. BESTODOL 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving BESTODOL 50 INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BESTODOL 50 INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How BESTODOL 50 INJECTION Works

BESTODOL 50 INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use BESTODOL 50 INJECTION

BESTODOL 50 INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About INTAP 100MG TABLET

INTAP 100MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

INTAP 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

INTAP 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

INTAP 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. INTAP 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking INTAP 100MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of INTAP 100MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How INTAP 100MG TABLET Works

INTAP 100MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. INTAP 100MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Take INTAP 100MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have tendency towards fits

introduction:
Introduction About DURAPAIN 20MG CAPSULE

DURAPAIN 20MG CAPSULE is a combination of Diclofenac and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and Opiate analgesics respectively. DURAPAIN 20MG CAPSULE is used in the management of pain and inflammation (redness and swelling). Pain is an unpleasant sensation that occurs with tissue damage. It helps the body to react and manage further tissue damage. It can be short-term (acute) or long-term (chronic) and the perception of pain can differ from one person to other.

Before taking DURAPAIN 20MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gastric bleeding, severe heart failure, high blood pressure, and liver or kidney disease. DURAPAIN 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended in pregnant women, children and adolescents below 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking. DURAPAIN 20MG CAPSULE is excreted into breast milk so it not recommended in breastfeeding women, but if deemed necessary you should stop breast-feeding during the management with DURAPAIN 20MG CAPSULE.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DURAPAIN 20MG CAPSULE because it might make you dizzier. The common side effects of DURAPAIN 20MG CAPSULE nausea, loss of appetite, vomiting, dizziness, indigestion, sleepiness, constipation, heartburn, stomach pain and dryness in the mouth. If any of these side effects become worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system which blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.

introduction:
Introduction About TRANZAT 50MG CAPSULE

TRANZAT 50MG CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRANZAT 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRANZAT 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRANZAT 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRANZAT 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRANZAT 50MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)

Uses Of TRANZAT 50MG CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRANZAT 50MG CAPSULE Works

TRANZAT 50MG CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

Introduction About TROMAFRE 325/37.5MG TABLET

TROMAFRE 325/37.5MG TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TROMAFRE 325/37.5MG TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TROMAFRE 325/37.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TROMAFRE 325/37.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TROMAFRE 325/37.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TROMAFRE 325/37.5MG TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET

DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET Works

DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Take DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). Others

DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Before taking DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

Use in paediatrics:

DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.     

 Use in geriatrics:

DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking DUOVOLT ER 100MG TABLET.

Do not drive or use any machinery while taking ALENFAST 100MG TABLET if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impairment of reactions. 

Alcohol

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ALENFAST 100MG TABLET as it may increase the effect of drowsiness.

Kidney

ALENFAST 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking ALENFAST 100MG TABLET. 

Liver

ALENFAST 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. ALENFAST 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with moderate liver problems and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking ALENFAST 100MG TABLET.  

Allergy

Do not take ALENFAST 100MG TABLET if you are allergic to Tapentadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

ALENFAST 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

ALENFAST 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

ALENFAST 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking ALENFAST 100MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About NEXDOL P TABLET

NEXDOL P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. NEXDOL P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking NEXDOL P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

NEXDOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

NEXDOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking NEXDOL P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEXDOL P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How NEXDOL P TABLET Works

NEXDOL P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use NEXDOL P TABLET

Take NEXDOL P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take NEXDOL P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DURAPAIN 60MG CAPSULE

DURAPAIN 60MG CAPSULE is a combination of Diclofenac and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and Opiate analgesics respectively. DURAPAIN 60MG CAPSULE is used in the management of pain and inflammation (redness and swelling). Pain is an unpleasant sensation that occurs with tissue damage. It helps the body to react and manage further tissue damage. It can be short-term (acute) or long-term (chronic) and the perception of pain can differ from one person to other.

Before taking DURAPAIN 60MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gastric bleeding, severe heart failure, high blood pressure, and liver or kidney disease. DURAPAIN 60MG CAPSULE is not recommended in pregnant women, children and adolescents below 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking. DURAPAIN 60MG CAPSULE is excreted into breast milk so it not recommended in breastfeeding women, but if deemed necessary you should stop breast-feeding during the management with DURAPAIN 60MG CAPSULE.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DURAPAIN 60MG CAPSULE because it might make you dizzier. The common side effects of DURAPAIN 60MG CAPSULE nausea, loss of appetite, vomiting, dizziness, indigestion, sleepiness, constipation, heartburn, stomach pain and dryness in the mouth. If any of these side effects become worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: Used to manage pain and inflammation (redness and swelling)
usesDetails:
Uses Of DURAPAIN 60MG CAPSULE
Used to manage pain and inflammation (redness and swelling)
mechanismOfAction:
How DURAPAIN 60MG CAPSULE Works

DURAPAIN 60MG CAPSULE contains Diclofenac and Tramadol. Diclofenac works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system which blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.

Take DURAPAIN 60MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMBAX OD 100 TABLET

TRAMBAX OD 100 TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAMBAX OD 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAMBAX OD 100 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAMBAX OD 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMBAX OD 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMBAX OD 100 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMBAX OD 100 TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMBAX OD 100 TABLET Works

TRAMBAX OD 100 TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

Take TRAMBAX OD 100 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TAPENAX ER 100MG TABLET

TAPENAX ER 100MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPENAX ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPENAX ER 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPENAX ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPENAX ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPENAX ER 100MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How TAPENAX ER 100MG TABLET Works

TAPENAX ER 100MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPENAX ER 100MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Introduction About TRAMAZIDE 50MG TABLET

TRAMAZIDE 50MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAMAZIDE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAMAZIDE 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAMAZIDE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMAZIDE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMAZIDE 50MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAZIDE 50MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAZIDE 50MG TABLET Works

TRAMAZIDE 50MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

How to use TRAMAZIDE 50MG TABLET

Take TRAMAZIDE 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMBAX 100MG TABLET Works

TRAMBAX 100MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
