introduction:
Introduction About TRILODOL P TABLET

TRILODOL P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRILODOL P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRILODOL P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRILODOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRILODOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRILODOL P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRILODOL P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRILODOL P TABLET Works

TRILODOL P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

Take TRILODOL P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRILODOL P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Urgendol 50mg Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION

URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION Works

URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION

URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women planning to have a baby because the baby may become dependent and may show withdrawal symptoms after the birth. Consult your doctor before receiving URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION.

URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and will affect the baby. Consult your doctor before receiving URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impaired reaction after receiving URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION.
Do not consume alcohol while receiving URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION as it may increase the effects of this medicine.
URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION.
URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION.
Do not receive URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

Before receiving URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION to your child. 

Use in geriatrics:

URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving URGENDOL 50MG INJECTION

Carbamazepine (used to manage fits)
Ondansetron (used to manage or manage nausea)
Monoamine oxidase inhibitors (medicines used to manage depression) Ex. moclobemide, phenelzine and selegiline (used to manage Parkinson's disease)

name: TRD Contin 100mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TRD CONTIN 100MG TABLET

TRD CONTIN 100MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRD CONTIN 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRD CONTIN 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRD CONTIN 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRD CONTIN 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRD CONTIN 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

name: Tramanam Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TRAMANAM TABLET

TRAMANAM TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAMANAM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAMANAM TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAMANAM TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMANAM TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMANAM TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMANAM TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMANAM TABLET Works

TRAMANAM TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMANAM TABLET

Take TRAMANAM TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Before receiving CENTRADOL 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

The most common side effects of receiving CENTRADOL 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Introduction About TRUMP 50MG TABLET

TRUMP 50MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRUMP 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRUMP 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRUMP 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRUMP 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRUMP 50MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

Uses Of TRUMP 50MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRUMP 50MG TABLET Works

TRUMP 50MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAXOL TABLET

TRAXOL TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAXOL TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAXOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAXOL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAXOL TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAXOL TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAXOL TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAXOL TABLET Works

TRAXOL TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

Take TRAXOL TABLET as advised by your physician.

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAXOL TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: ULTRIN SEMI Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ULTRIN SEMI TABLET

ULTRIN SEMI TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ULTRIN SEMI TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ULTRIN SEMI TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ULTRIN SEMI TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ULTRIN SEMI TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ULTRIN SEMI TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ULTRIN SEMI TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRIN SEMI TABLET Works

ULTRIN SEMI TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRIN SEMI TABLET

Take ULTRIN SEMI TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ULTRIN SEMI TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Medicines used to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. metoclopramide, domperidone or ondansetron)
Medicines used against infections (Ex. ketoconazole, flucloxacillin, erythromycin)
Medicine used to reduce cholesterol in the blood (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicine used in the management of depression or Parkinson’s disease (Ex. monoamine oxidase inhibitors such as phenelzine, isocarboxazid)  
Amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Medicine used to help stop smoking (Ex. bupropion)
Baclofen (used as muscle relaxant)
Warfarin, phenprocoumon (used to manage or manage blood clots)
Medicine used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine)
Morphine, buprenorphine, nalbuphine or pentazocine (used to manage severe pain)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ULTRIN SEMI TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of ULTRIN SEMI TABLET includes loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, malaise, pallor, excess sweating, respiratory depression and seizures.

name: ULTRANICHE T Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ULTRANICHE T TABLET

ULTRANICHE T TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

ULTRANICHE T TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

ULTRANICHE T TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

ULTRANICHE T TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. ULTRANICHE T TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking ULTRANICHE T TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of ULTRANICHE T TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRANICHE T TABLET Works

ULTRANICHE T TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. ULTRANICHE T TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRANICHE T TABLET

Take ULTRANICHE T TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAZAC TC TABLET

TRAMAZAC TC TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAMAZAC TC TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAMAZAC TC TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAMAZAC TC TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMAZAC TC TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMAZAC TC TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAZAC TC TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAZAC TC TABLET Works

TRAMAZAC TC TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMAZAC TC TABLET

Take TRAMAZAC TC TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About NIAP 75MG TABLET

NIAP 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

NIAP 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. NIAP 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking NIAP 75MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION

ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION Works

ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION

ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines)

Before receiving ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shock state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). Use in geriatrics:

ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving ULTRAMOL 100MG INJECTION.

introduction:
Introduction About TREMSOL TABLET

TREMSOL TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TREMSOL TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TREMSOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TREMSOL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TREMSOL TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TREMSOL TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TREMSOL TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TREMSOL TABLET Works

TREMSOL TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TREMSOL TABLET

Take TREMSOL TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TREMSOL TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: TRALOFEN Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TRALOFEN TABLET

TRALOFEN TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and Opiate analgesics respectively. TRALOFEN TABLET is used in the management of pain and inflammation (redness and swelling). Pain is an unpleasant sensation that occurs with tissue damage. It helps the body to react and manage further tissue damage. It can be short-term (acute) or long-term (chronic) and the perception of pain can differ from one person to other.

Before taking TRALOFEN TABLET, inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gastric bleeding, severe heart failure, high blood pressure, and liver or kidney disease. TRALOFEN TABLET is not recommended in pregnant women, children and adolescents below 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking. TRALOFEN TABLET is excreted into breast milk so it not recommended in breastfeeding women, but if deemed necessary you should stop breast-feeding during the management with TRALOFEN TABLET.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TRALOFEN TABLET because it might make you dizzier. The common side effects of TRALOFEN TABLET nausea, loss of appetite, vomiting, dizziness, indigestion, sleepiness, constipation, heartburn, stomach pain and dryness in the mouth. If any of these side effects become worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: Used to manage pain and inflammation (redness and swelling)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRALOFEN TABLET
Used to manage pain and inflammation (redness and swelling)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRALOFEN TABLET Works

TRALOFEN TABLET contains Diclofenac and Tramadol. Diclofenac works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system which blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRALOFEN TABLET

Take TRALOFEN TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking TRALOFEN TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used against infections. (Ex. ketoconazole, flucloxacillin, erythromycin)
Medicine used to reduce cholesterol in the blood (Ex. cholestyramine)
HIV medications (Ex. indinavir, nelfinavir, ritonavir) 
Medicines used to manage abnormal heart rhythms (Ex. quinidine)
Medicine used in the management of depression or Parkinson’s disease (Ex. monoamine oxidase inhibitors)
Antidepressants (Ex. amitriptyline)
Blood pressure-lowering agents (Ex. hydrochlorothiazide)
Medicines that affect the state of mind, used to help stop smoking (Ex. bupropion)
Blood thinning medicines (Ex. warfarin)
Painkillers (Ex. nimesulide, oxyphenbutazone)
Medicine used to manage epilepsy or some types of pain (Ex. carbamazepine)
Opioid-type pain relievers (Ex. buprenorphine, nalbuphine or pentazocine)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of TRALOFEN TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms may include headache, nausea, pain abdominal, vomiting, bleeding intestinal or stomach, drowsiness, excitation, diarrhoea, disorientation, rarely convulsions may occur.

introduction:
Introduction About THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION

THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION Works

THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION

THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and will affect the baby. Consult your doctor before receiving THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impaired reaction after receiving THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION.
Do not consume alcohol while receiving THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION as it may increase the effects of this medicine.
THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION.
THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION.
Do not receive THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

Before receiving THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION to your child. 

Use in geriatrics:

THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving THEMIDOL 50MG INJECTION

name: Resync Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About RESYNC TABLET

RESYNC TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and Opiate analgesics respectively. RESYNC TABLET is used in the management of pain and inflammation (redness and swelling). Pain is an unpleasant sensation that occurs with tissue damage. It helps the body to react and manage further tissue damage. It can be short-term (acute) or long-term (chronic) and the perception of pain can differ from one person to other.

Before taking RESYNC TABLET, inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gastric bleeding, severe heart failure, high blood pressure, and liver or kidney disease. RESYNC TABLET is not recommended in pregnant women, children and adolescents below 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking. RESYNC TABLET is excreted into breast milk so it not recommended in breastfeeding women, but if deemed necessary you should stop breast-feeding during the management with RESYNC TABLET.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking RESYNC TABLET because it might make you dizzier. The common side effects of RESYNC TABLET nausea, loss of appetite, vomiting, dizziness, indigestion, sleepiness, constipation, heartburn, stomach pain and dryness in the mouth. If any of these side effects become worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: Used to manage pain and inflammation (redness and swelling)
usesDetails:
Uses Of RESYNC TABLET
Used to manage pain and inflammation (redness and swelling)
mechanismOfAction:
How RESYNC TABLET Works

RESYNC TABLET contains Diclofenac and Tramadol. Diclofenac works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system which blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.
usageDetails:
How to use RESYNC TABLET

Take RESYNC TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

name: TRAPSURE 100 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TRAPSURE 100 TABLET

TRAPSURE 100 TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAPSURE 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAPSURE 100 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAPSURE 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAPSURE 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAPSURE 100 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAPSURE 100 TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAPSURE 100 TABLET Works

TRAPSURE 100 TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAPSURE 100 TABLET

Take TRAPSURE 100 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Tricare Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TRICARE TABLET

TRICARE TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRICARE TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRICARE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRICARE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRICARE TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRICARE TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRICARE TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRICARE TABLET Works

TRICARE TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRICARE TABLET

Take TRICARE TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRICARE TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NUDOL 50 TABLET

NUDOL 50 TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

NUDOL 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

NUDOL 50 TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

NUDOL 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. NUDOL 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking NUDOL 50 TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of NUDOL 50 TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How NUDOL 50 TABLET Works

NUDOL 50 TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. NUDOL 50 TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

warnings.details: NUDOL 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor as it can cause withdrawal symptoms in the new-born baby when used for prolonged period of time, which might be life threatening and could also possibly lead to dangerously slow or shallow breathing in the newborn. Consult with your doctor before taking NUDOL 50 TABLET.
NUDOL 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking NUDOL 50 TABLET.
Do not drive or use any machinery while taking NUDOL 50 TABLET if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impairment of reactions.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NUDOL 50 TABLET as it may increase the effect of drowsiness.

NUDOL 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking NUDOL 50 TABLET.

NUDOL 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. NUDOL 50 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with moderate liver problems and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking NUDOL 50 TABLET.
Do not take NUDOL 50 TABLET if you are allergic to Tapentadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

NUDOL 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). It should be used with caution in patients having other breathing issues (slow or shallow breathing). Consult your doctor before taking NUDOL 50 TABLET.

Others

NUDOL 50 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Before taking NUDOL 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

Use in paediatrics:

NUDOL 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.     

 Use in geriatrics:

NUDOL 50 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking NUDOL 50 TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug–Drug Interactions:

Before taking NUDOL 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Sedatives such as zolpidem, barbiturates (Ex. amobarbital, pentobarbital) antidepressants such as paroxetine, sertraline and anti-psychotics such as loxapine, clozapine, monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) such as isocarboxazid (used to manage depression, anxiety, mood disorders, sleep disturbances) 
Opioids such as codeine, oxymorphone, mixed mu-opioid agonist/antagonists such as pentazocine, nalbuphine, partial mu-opioid agonists such as buprenorphine (used to manage severe pain)
Antihistamines such as cetirizine, loratadine (used to manage allergy)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
St. john’s wort (herbal medicine used to manage depression)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of NUDOL 50 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of NUDOL 50 TABLET are pin-point pupils, vomiting, fast heartbeat, drop in blood pressure, collapse, disturbed consciousness or coma (deep unconsciousness), epileptic fits (convulsions), dangerously slow or shallow breathing or stopping breathing may occur.

LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET.
Do not drive or use any machinery while taking LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impairment of reactions.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET as it may increase the effect of drowsiness.

LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET.

LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with moderate liver problems and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET.
Do not take LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET if you are allergic to Tapentadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). It should be used with caution in patients having other breathing issues (slow or shallow breathing). Consult your doctor before taking LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET.

Others

LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Before taking LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

Use in paediatrics:

LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.     

 Use in geriatrics:

LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug–Drug Interactions:

Before taking LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Sedatives such as zolpidem, barbiturates (Ex. amobarbital, pentobarbital) antidepressants such as paroxetine, sertraline and anti-psychotics such as loxapine, clozapine, monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) such as isocarboxazid (used to manage depression, anxiety, mood disorders, sleep disturbances) 
Opioids such as codeine, oxymorphone, mixed mu-opioid agonist/antagonists such as pentazocine, nalbuphine, partial mu-opioid agonists such as buprenorphine (used to manage severe pain)
Antihistamines such as cetirizine, loratadine (used to manage allergy)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
St. john’s wort (herbal medicine used to manage depression)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of LUCYNTA 75MG TABLET are pin-point pupils, vomiting, fast heartbeat, drop in blood pressure, collapse, disturbed consciousness or coma (deep unconsciousness), epileptic fits (convulsions), dangerously slow or shallow breathing or stopping breathing may occur.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK

TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK Works

TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK

TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

Before receiving TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK to your child. 

Use in geriatrics:

TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMAZAC INJECTION HOSPITAL PACK

name: Ultra Plus Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ULTRA PLUS TABLET

ULTRA PLUS TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ULTRA PLUS TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking ULTRA PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ULTRA PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ULTRA PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ULTRA PLUS TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ULTRA PLUS TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRA PLUS TABLET Works

ULTRA PLUS TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRA PLUS TABLET

Take ULTRA PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ULTRA PLUS TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NICODOL PLUS TABLET

NICODOL PLUS TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. NICODOL PLUS TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking NICODOL PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

NICODOL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

NICODOL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking NICODOL PLUS TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NICODOL PLUS TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How NICODOL PLUS TABLET Works

NICODOL PLUS TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use NICODOL PLUS TABLET

Take NICODOL PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take NICODOL PLUS TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CODEINE PHOSPHATE LINCTUS

CODEINE PHOSPHATE LINCTUS contains Codeine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used to provide relief from dry cough. Dry cough is a cough which does not produce any sputum.

Before taking CODEINE PHOSPHATE LINCTUS inform your doctor if you have any previous history of drug abuse, addiction or developed withdrawal symptoms after stopping an opioid medication.

You must also inform your doctor if you have any liver problems, kidney problems, breathing difficulties (Ex. asthma) or thyroid problems as a precaution. Take CODEINE PHOSPHATE LINCTUS only for the duration recommended by your doctor. Do not overuse or misuse this medicine as it may make you feel getting addicted to it.

Do not take CODEINE PHOSPHATE LINCTUS without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking CODEINE PHOSPHATE LINCTUS are drowsiness, nausea, vomiting, constipation, loss of appetite, flushing of the face and slow or shallow breathing. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CODEINE PHOSPHATE LINCTUS
Relieves dry cough
mechanismOfAction:
How CODEINE PHOSPHATE LINCTUS Works

CODEINE PHOSPHATE LINCTUS is an opioid medication. It works by suppressing the activity of certain parts of the brain that triggers cough reflexes. Therefore, it provides relief from cough, especially dry cough.
usageDetails:
How to use CODEINE PHOSPHATE LINCTUS

Take CODEINE PHOSPHATE LINCTUS as advised by your physician. Shake the medicine well before use. Measure the required quantity of the medicine in a measuring cup and consume it immediately.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

name: TRENTADOL Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TRENTADOL TABLET

TRENTADOL TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TRENTADOL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TRENTADOL TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TRENTADOL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TRENTADOL TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TRENTADOL TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRENTADOL TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TRENTADOL TABLET Works

TRENTADOL TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TRENTADOL TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use TRENTADOL TABLET

Take TRENTADOL TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NIAP 100MG TABLET

NIAP 100MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

NIAP 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

NIAP 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

NIAP 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. NIAP 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking NIAP 100MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

usesDetails:
Uses Of NIAP 100MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How NIAP 100MG TABLET Works

NIAP 100MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. NIAP 100MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Take NIAP 100MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About VICTADOL P TABLET

VICTADOL P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. VICTADOL P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking VICTADOL P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

VICTADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

VICTADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking VICTADOL P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of VICTADOL P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How VICTADOL P TABLET Works

VICTADOL P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use VICTADOL P TABLET

Take VICTADOL P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take VICTADOL P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About BUPREPLAST 5MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH

BUPREPLAST 5MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH contains Buprenorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Strong analgesics. It is used to provide relief from moderate long-lasting pain that requires the use of a strong painkiller in affected individuals.

Pain is an uncomfortable sensation in the body that stems from the activation of nervous system which generally occurs as an annoying or debilitating sensation generally characterized by symptoms such as as a sharp, dull, throbbing, pinching, stinging and/or burning sensation in affected individuals.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while using BUPREPLAST 5MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH. This medicine is not recommended for use in patients with breathing problems, addiction to drugs and/or myasthenia gravis (condition that weakness muscles). Before using [GNKEYWORD], inform your doctor if you suffer from sleep apnoea (a breathing related sleep disorder), severe liver problems and/or kidney diseases.

BUPREPLAST 5MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

The most common side effects associated with the use of BUPREPLAST 5MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH are headache, dizziness, drowsiness, constipation, nausea, vomiting and itchy skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Provides relief from moderate long-lasting pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of BUPREPLAST 5MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH
Provides relief from moderate long-lasting pain
mechanismOfAction:
How BUPREPLAST 5MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH Works

BUPREPLAST 5MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH works by blocking certain receptors (responsible for pain) in the brain and spinal cord which leads to blockade of pain transmission thus providing relief from moderate and long-lasting pain in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use BUPREPLAST 5MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH

Use BUPREPLAST 5MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH as advised by your physician. Wash and dry the area where the transdermal patch must be placed. Choose a non-irritated, intact skin, relatively hairless or nearly hairless skin area on your upper arm, outer arm, upper chest, upper back, or side of the chest to apply the patch. The sticky side of the patch is protected with a silvery protective foil which is carefully removed without touching the sticky part of the patch. Stick the patch on to the chosen area of the skin and remove the foil.

Press the patch against the skin with your palm and count to 30 seconds slowly. Ensure, the whole patch is in contact with your skin, especially at the edges. The patch should be worn for seven days. Avoid exposing the patch to extreme heat. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMADEX 50 CAPSULE

TRAMADEX 50 CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAMADEX 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAMADEX 50 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAMADEX 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMADEX 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMADEX 50 CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMADEX 50 CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMADEX 50 CAPSULE Works

TRAMADEX 50 CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMADEX 50 CAPSULE

Take TRAMADEX 50 CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
