introduction:
Introduction About BUTRUM 1MG INJECTION

BUTRUM 1MG INJECTION contains Butorphanol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioid agonist/antagonist analgesics. It is used to manage and relieve moderate to severe pain. It is also used as a preoperative/pre-anaesthetic medication, a supplement to balanced anaesthesia, to provide relief from pain during labor and in the management of severe pain for which alternative management is inadequate.

BUTRUM 1MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with lung problems (such as respiratory depression, acute/severe bronchial asthma) and gastrointestinal obstruction (such as paralytic ileus). Before taking BUTRUM 1MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have a dependency on narcotics, suffer from cachexia (a condition marked by extreme weight loss and muscle wasting), seizure disorders or hepatic and/or kidney impairment.

BUTRUM 1MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years).

The most common side effects associated with the use of BUTRUM 1MG INJECTION are excessive sleepiness, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, nasal congestion, sleeplessness and/or lethargy. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About NEWTAP 100MG TABLET

NEWTAP 100MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

NEWTAP 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

NEWTAP 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

NEWTAP 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. NEWTAP 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking NEWTAP 100MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

usesDetails:
Uses Of NEWTAP 100MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How NEWTAP 100MG TABLET Works

NEWTAP 100MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. NEWTAP 100MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

introduction:
Introduction About CGMAC P TABLET

CGMAC P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. CGMAC P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking CGMAC P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

CGMAC P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

CGMAC P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking CGMAC P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CGMAC P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How CGMAC P TABLET Works

CGMAC P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

Take CGMAC P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take CGMAC P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About GUFIDOL 100MG INJECTION

GUFIDOL 100MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

GUFIDOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving GUFIDOL 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

GUFIDOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. GUFIDOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving GUFIDOL 100MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of GUFIDOL 100MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How GUFIDOL 100MG INJECTION Works

GUFIDOL 100MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

How to use GUFIDOL 100MG INJECTION

GUFIDOL 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Difficulty breathing, rash or itchy skin, swollen face or tongue or difficulty in swallowing
Sleep-related breathing disorders or hypoexmia (signs include breathing pauses during sleep, night awakening due to shortness of breath, difficulties to maintain sleep or excessive drowsiness during the day)

Have a feeling of fainting

introduction:
Introduction About TRAM PROXYVON CAPSULE

TRAM PROXYVON CAPSULE is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAM PROXYVON CAPSULE is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAM PROXYVON CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAM PROXYVON CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAM PROXYVON CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAM PROXYVON CAPSULE are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAM PROXYVON CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAM PROXYVON CAPSULE Works

TRAM PROXYVON CAPSULE contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAM PROXYVON CAPSULE

Take TRAM PROXYVON CAPSULE as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAM PROXYVON CAPSULE by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Axtra Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AXTRA TABLET

AXTRA TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. AXTRA TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking AXTRA TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

AXTRA TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

AXTRA TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking AXTRA TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AXTRA TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How AXTRA TABLET Works

AXTRA TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use AXTRA TABLET

Take AXTRA TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take AXTRA TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Centradol 50mg Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About CENTRADOL 50MG INJECTION

CENTRADOL 50MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

CENTRADOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving CENTRADOL 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

CENTRADOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. CENTRADOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving CENTRADOL 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CENTRADOL 50MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How CENTRADOL 50MG INJECTION Works

CENTRADOL 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use CENTRADOL 50MG INJECTION

CENTRADOL 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About INTAP 75MG TABLET

INTAP 75MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

INTAP 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

INTAP 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

INTAP 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. INTAP 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking INTAP 75MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

usesDetails:
Uses Of INTAP 75MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How INTAP 75MG TABLET Works

INTAP 75MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. INTAP 75MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Take INTAP 75MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

A. Drug–Drug Interactions:

Before taking INTAP 75MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
St. john’s wort (herbal medicine used to manage depression)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of INTAP 75MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Introduction About CYNDOL 50MG TABLET

CYNDOL 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

CYNDOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

CYNDOL 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

CYNDOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. CYNDOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking CYNDOL 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CYNDOL 50MG TABLET Works

CYNDOL 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. CYNDOL 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

name: Paxmax Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PAXMAX TABLET

PAXMAX TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. PAXMAX TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking PAXMAX TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

PAXMAX TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

PAXMAX TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking PAXMAX TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PAXMAX TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How PAXMAX TABLET Works

PAXMAX TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use PAXMAX TABLET

Take PAXMAX TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take PAXMAX TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE

TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE Works

TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE

Take TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney insufficiency. Consult your doctor before taking TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE.

TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver insufficiency. TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with asthma or trouble breathing. Consult your doctor before taking TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE.

TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years) due to delayed excretion of this medicine and your doctor may prolong the dosing interval of TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE. Consult your doctor before taking TRAMADOL(AEQUITAS) 50MG CAPSULE.

introduction:
Introduction About WALTRA P TABLET

WALTRA P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. WALTRA P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking WALTRA P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

WALTRA P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

WALTRA P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking WALTRA P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

WALTRA P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use WALTRA P TABLET

Take WALTRA P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take WALTRA P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: WALTRA P TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
WALTRA P TABLET is not recommended for use during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel drowsy after taking WALTRA P TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking WALTRA P TABLET because it might make you feel drowsy and it is not recommended for use in patients with acute alcohol poisoning.
WALTRA P TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking WALTRA P TABLET.

WALTRA P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disorder and should be used with caution in patients with liver problems or jaundice. Consult your doctor before taking WALTRA P TABLET.
Do not take WALTRA P TABLET if you are allergic to Paracetamol, Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.
WALTRA P TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have severe difficulties in breathing like asthma or severe lung problems. Consult your doctor before taking WALTRA P TABLET.

Others

WALTRA P TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (which is not adequately controlled by your current medicine)
Known or suspected gastrointestinal obstruction including paralytic ileus

Before taking WALTRA P TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have epilepsy or already experienced fits or seizures
Have recently suffered from a head injury, shock or severe headaches associated with vomiting
Have intolerance to certain sugars
Have depression

Use in pediatrics:

WALTRA P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

WALTRA P TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking WALTRA P TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. metoclopramide, domperidone or ondansetron)
Medicines used against infections (Ex. ketoconazole, flucloxacillin, erythromycin)
Medicine used to reduce cholesterol in the blood (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicine used in the management of depression or Parkinson’s disease (Ex. monoamine oxidase inhibitors such as phenelzine, isocarboxazid)  
Amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Medicine used to help stop smoking (Ex. bupropion)
Baclofen (used as muscle relaxant)
Warfarin, phenprocoumon (used to manage or manage blood clots)
Medicine used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine)
Morphine, buprenorphine, nalbuphine or pentazocine (used to manage severe pain)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of WALTRA P TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of WALTRA P TABLET includes loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, malaise, pallor, excess sweating, respiratory depression and seizures.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMY TABLET

TRAMY TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAMY TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking TRAMY TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMY TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMY TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMY TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About URGENDOL P TABLET

URGENDOL P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. URGENDOL P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking URGENDOL P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

URGENDOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

URGENDOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking URGENDOL P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of URGENDOL P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How URGENDOL P TABLET Works

URGENDOL P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use URGENDOL P TABLET

Take URGENDOL P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take URGENDOL P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Nexdol SR Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NEXDOL SR TABLET

NEXDOL SR TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

NEXDOL SR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking NEXDOL SR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

NEXDOL SR TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. NEXDOL SR TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking NEXDOL SR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEXDOL SR TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How NEXDOL SR TABLET Works

NEXDOL SR TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About STRADOL P TABLET

STRADOL P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. STRADOL P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking STRADOL P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

STRADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

STRADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking STRADOL P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of STRADOL P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How STRADOL P TABLET Works

STRADOL P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use STRADOL P TABLET

Take STRADOL P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take STRADOL P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NOBLIGAN 50MG TABLET

NOBLIGAN 50MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

NOBLIGAN 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking NOBLIGAN 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

NOBLIGAN 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. NOBLIGAN 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking NOBLIGAN 50MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How NOBLIGAN 50MG TABLET Works

NOBLIGAN 50MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

Introduction About LUCYNTA 100MG TABLET

LUCYNTA 100MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

LUCYNTA 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

LUCYNTA 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

LUCYNTA 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. LUCYNTA 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking LUCYNTA 100MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Introduction About CYNDOL 75MG TABLET

CYNDOL 75MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

CYNDOL 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

CYNDOL 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

CYNDOL 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. CYNDOL 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking CYNDOL 75MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How CYNDOL 75MG TABLET Works

CYNDOL 75MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. CYNDOL 75MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Take CYNDOL 75MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION

CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION Works

CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION

CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women planning to have a baby because the baby may become dependent and may show withdrawal symptoms after the birth. Consult your doctor before receiving CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION.

Breastfeeding

CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and will affect the baby. Consult your doctor before receiving CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION.

Driving and Using Machines

Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impaired reaction after receiving CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION.

Alcohol

Do not consume alcohol while receiving CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION as it may increase the effects of this medicine.

Kidney

CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION.

Liver

CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION.

Allergy

Do not receive CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.  

Others

CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

Before receiving CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION to your child. 

Use in geriatrics:

CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION

Anticoagulants (medicines used to manage or manage blood clots) Ex. warfarin
Carbamazepine (used to manage fits)
Ondansetron (used to manage or manage nausea)
Monoamine oxidase inhibitors (medicines used to manage depression) Ex. moclobemide, phenelzine and selegiline (used to manage Parkinson's disease)

CONTRAMAL 50MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a physician or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your physician if you experience any unusual symptoms. introduction:
Introduction About KINEDOL EF EFFERVESCENT TABLET

KINEDOL EF EFFERVESCENT TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. KINEDOL EF EFFERVESCENT TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.  

Before taking KINEDOL EF EFFERVESCENT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

KINEDOL EF EFFERVESCENT TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

KINEDOL EF EFFERVESCENT TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking KINEDOL EF EFFERVESCENT TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KINEDOL EF EFFERVESCENT TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How KINEDOL EF EFFERVESCENT TABLET Works

KINEDOL EF EFFERVESCENT TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use KINEDOL EF EFFERVESCENT TABLET

Take KINEDOL EF EFFERVESCENT TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take KINEDOL EF EFFERVESCENT TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PRECIDOL TABLET

PRECIDOL TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. PRECIDOL TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking PRECIDOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

PRECIDOL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

PRECIDOL TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking PRECIDOL TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PRECIDOL TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How PRECIDOL TABLET Works

PRECIDOL TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use PRECIDOL TABLET

Take PRECIDOL TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take PRECIDOL TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMBAX 50MG TABLET

TRAMBAX 50MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAMBAX 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAMBAX 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAMBAX 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMBAX 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMBAX 50MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMBAX 50MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMBAX 50MG TABLET Works

TRAMBAX 50MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

Introduction About TAPEDAC 50 MG TABLET

TAPEDAC 50 MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPEDAC 50 MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPEDAC 50 MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPEDAC 50 MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPEDAC 50 MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPEDAC 50 MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NICOZOCINE 30MG INJECTION

NICOZOCINE 30MG INJECTION contains Pentazocine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opiate Analgesics. NICOZOCINE 30MG INJECTION is used to relieve moderate to severe pain. It may also be used for pre-operative or pre-anesthetic medication and as a supplement to surgical anesthesia. Avoid consuming alcohol, tobacco, and smoking while receiving NICOZOCINE 30MG INJECTION as it can increase the side effects.

Do not receive NICOZOCINE 30MG INJECTION if you have severe asthma, trouble breathing, or other breathing problems, heart problems, bowel blockage or narrowing of the stomach or intestines, severe pain in the abdomen due to acute appendicitis or pancreatitis, acute respiratory depression, head injury, a risk for seizures, undergone a surgery or are planned to undergo a surgery therefore, consult your doctor before receiving. NICOZOCINE 30MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients who have severe kidney, liver and lung disease, heart disease, migraines, chronic or severe constipation, thyroid, adrenal or prostate gland disorders, low blood pressure, psychiatric problems such as depression, hallucinations or other mental problems, consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

NICOZOCINE 30MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women until necessary, therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it. NICOZOCINE 30MG INJECTION is not recommended for administration in children and adolescents less than 12 years of age, consult your doctor for advice. NICOZOCINE 30MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, therefore consult your doctor before receiving. The most common side effects after receiving NICOZOCINE 30MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, sedation, sweating, dizziness, euphoria and light-headedness. Consult your doctor immediately in case any of the side effects worsen or you experience an allergic reaction after receiving NICOZOCINE 30MG INJECTION.

introduction:
Introduction About GUDRIL TABLET

GUDRIL TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. GUDRIL TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking GUDRIL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

GUDRIL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

GUDRIL TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking GUDRIL TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of GUDRIL TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How GUDRIL TABLET Works

GUDRIL TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use GUDRIL TABLET

Take GUDRIL TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take GUDRIL TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

mechanismOfAction:

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking ULTRAMUST P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ULTRAMUST P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ULTRAMUST P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ULTRAMUST P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRAMUST P TABLET Works

ULTRAMUST P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRAMUST P TABLET

Take ULTRAMUST P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ULTRAMUST P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking ULTRAMUST P TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. metoclopramide, domperidone or ondansetron)
Medicines used against infections (Ex. ketoconazole, flucloxacillin, erythromycin)
Medicine used to reduce cholesterol in the blood (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicine used in the management of depression or Parkinson’s disease (Ex. monoamine oxidase inhibitors such as phenelzine, isocarboxazid)  
Amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Medicine used to help stop smoking (Ex. bupropion)
Baclofen (used as muscle relaxant)
Warfarin, phenprocoumon (used to manage or manage blood clots)
Medicine used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine)
Morphine, buprenorphine, nalbuphine or pentazocine (used to manage severe pain)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ULTRAMUST P TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of ULTRAMUST P TABLET includes loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, malaise, pallor, excess sweating, respiratory depression and seizures.

introduction:
Introduction About BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION

BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION contains Butorphanol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioid agonist/antagonist analgesics. It is used to manage and relieve moderate to severe pain. It is also used as a preoperative/pre-anaesthetic medication, a supplement to balanced anaesthesia, to provide relief from pain during labor and in the management of severe pain for which alternative management is inadequate.

BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with lung problems (such as respiratory depression, acute/severe bronchial asthma) and gastrointestinal obstruction (such as paralytic ileus). Before taking BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have a dependency on narcotics, suffer from cachexia (a condition marked by extreme weight loss and muscle wasting), seizure disorders or hepatic and/or kidney impairment.

BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years).

The most common side effects associated with the use of BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION are excessive sleepiness, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, nasal congestion, sleeplessness and/or lethargy. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse.

warnings.details: BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is necessary as prolonged use of this medicine might cause physical dependence and neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome in new-born which can be associated with symptoms such as irritability, abnormal sleep pattern, high-pitched crying and tremors. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary as it can pass through breastfed milk. Stop breastfeeding your baby and consult your doctor immediately if your baby develops increased sleepiness, breathing difficulties and/or limpness after breastfeeding. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

Do not drive or operate machines after receiving BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION as it can impair the mental and/or physical abilities to drive or operate machinery. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION as it may cause substance abuse, profound sedation, respiratory depression and/or coma.
BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with renal impairment. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
Do not receive BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION if you are allergic to butorphanol tartrate and/or any other ingredients in this medicine.

BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with lung problems such as significant respiratory depression or acute/severe bronchial asthma (in an unmonitored setting). It should be used with caution in patients with other lung diseases such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, substantially decreased respiratory reserve, hypoxia, hypercapnia and/or respiratory impairment. Consult your doctor before receiving the medication.

BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases such as acute myocardial infarction, ventricular dysfunction and/or coronary insufficiency only if clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Others

BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have/suspected of gastrointestinal obstruction such as paralytic ileus

Before receiving BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Are dependent on narcotics
Suffer from cachexia (a condition marked by extreme weight loss and muscle wasting)
Are a debilitated patient
Have a head injury and suffer from impaired consciousness and/or coma
Have seizure disorders

Use in Paediatrics

BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Use in Geriatrics

BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before receiving BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Sedatives/hypnotics (medicines used to manage sleep disorders) such as barbiturates Ex. amobarbital
Anxiolytics or tranquilizers such as benzodiazepines (medicines used to manage anxiety) Ex. diazepam
Medicines used to manage depression, such as selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (Ex. citalopram), serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (Ex. paroxetine), tricyclic antidepressants (Ex. amoxapine)
Medicines that can affect the metabolism of certain drugs in the liver (Ex. erythromycin, theophylline)
Monoamine oxidase (MAO) inhibitors (medicines used to manage psychiatric disorders) Ex. linezolid, intravenous methylene blue
Triptans (medicines used to manage migraine) Ex. sumatriptan
5-HT3 receptor antagonists (medicines used to manage nausea and vomiting) Ex. ondansetron
Mirtazapine, trazodone, tramadol (medicines that affect the serotonin neurotransmitter system)
Muscle relaxants (medicines used for muscle relaxation) Ex. cyclobenzaprine, metaxalone
General anaesthetics (medicines used to minimize pain threshold in the whole body) Ex. propofol
Antipsychotics (medicines used to manage psychotic disorders) Ex. risperidone
Other opioids (medicines used to block opioid receptors) Ex. fentanyl

Overdosage:

BUTODOL 2MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or nurse in a hospital, so it is unlikely for you to receive an overdose. However, if you experience any unusual symptoms, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms may include respiratory depression, sleepiness that may prolong to the state of loss of consciousness/coma, skeletal muscle flaccidity, cold & clammy skin, constricted pupils, swelling in the lungs, low heart rate, low blood pressure, partial/complete airway obstruction, atypical snoring and/or hypoxia.

introduction:
Introduction About RIDDOF

RIDDOF contains Pentazocine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opiate Analgesics. RIDDOF is used to relieve moderate to severe pain. It may also be used for pre-operative or pre-anesthetic medication and as a supplement to surgical anesthesia. Avoid consuming alcohol, tobacco, and smoking while receiving RIDDOF as it can increase the side effects.

Do not receive RIDDOF if you have severe asthma, trouble breathing, or other breathing problems, heart problems, bowel blockage or narrowing of the stomach or intestines, severe pain in the abdomen due to acute appendicitis or pancreatitis, acute respiratory depression, head injury, a risk for seizures, undergone a surgery or are planned to undergo a surgery therefore, consult your doctor before receiving. RIDDOF should be used with caution in patients who have severe kidney, liver and lung disease, heart disease, migraines, chronic or severe constipation, thyroid, adrenal or prostate gland disorders, low blood pressure, psychiatric problems such as depression, hallucinations or other mental problems, consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

RIDDOF is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women until necessary, therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it. RIDDOF is not recommended for administration in children and adolescents less than 12 years of age, consult your doctor for advice. RIDDOF should be used with caution in elderly patients, therefore consult your doctor before receiving. The most common side effects after receiving RIDDOF are nausea, vomiting, sedation, sweating, dizziness, euphoria and light-headedness. Consult your doctor immediately in case any of the side effects worsen or you experience an allergic reaction after receiving RIDDOF.

Introduction About RAMCET 100 INJECTION

RAMCET 100 INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

RAMCET 100 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving RAMCET 100 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

RAMCET 100 INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. RAMCET 100 INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving RAMCET 100 INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RAMCET 100 INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How RAMCET 100 INJECTION Works

RAMCET 100 INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:

RAMCET 100 INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

RAMCET 100 INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving RAMCET 100 INJECTION.
interactions:

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving RAMCET 100 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:  

Benzodiazepines (medicines used to manage anxiety or sleep problems) Ex. diazepam, lorazepam
Anticoagulants (medicines used to manage or manage blood clots) Ex. warfarin
Carbamazepine (used to manage fits)
Ondansetron (used to manage or manage nausea)
Monoamine oxidase inhibitors (medicines used to manage depression) Ex. moclobemide, phenelzine and selegiline (used to manage parkinson’s disease)

RAMCET 100 INJECTION will be administered to you only by a physician or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. introduction:
Introduction About DELPODOL TABLET

DELPODOL TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. DELPODOL TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking DELPODOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

DELPODOL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

DELPODOL TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking DELPODOL TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DELPODOL TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How DELPODOL TABLET Works

DELPODOL TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use DELPODOL TABLET

Take DELPODOL TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take DELPODOL TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
