name: OMUDOL Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About OMUDOL TABLET

OMUDOL TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. OMUDOL TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking OMUDOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

OMUDOL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

OMUDOL TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking OMUDOL TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of OMUDOL TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How OMUDOL TABLET Works

OMUDOL TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use OMUDOL TABLET

Take OMUDOL TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take OMUDOL TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RINTRAM P TABLET

RINTRAM P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. RINTRAM P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking RINTRAM P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

RINTRAM P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

RINTRAM P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking RINTRAM P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RINTRAM P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How RINTRAM P TABLET Works

RINTRAM P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use RINTRAM P TABLET

Take RINTRAM P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take RINTRAM P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH

DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH contains Fentanyl which belongs to the group of medicine called Opioid Analgesics. It is used to manage severe long-lasting pain. It can also be used in the management of chronic cancer pain and other severe pains that is not controlled by conventional pain killers.

DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 2 years or above) who need continuous pain management. Before using DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems.

You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma or any other breathing problems, low blood pressure, mental health problems, chronic alcoholism or a previous history of drug abuse as a precaution.

DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects. When DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH is used in children, carefully monitor your child’s health condition. Make sure that they do not peel the patch or accidentally swallow the medicine, as it could lead to fatal outcomes.

Be cautious of storing the medicine strictly out of reach of children. Adults using DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH should make sure that the medicine is not accidentally stuck to their children or to other family members while coming in close contact.

Repeated or long-term use of DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH may make the medicine less effective for you as it may make you more dependent on it. Therefore, if you notice that your medicine becomes less effective, consult your doctor.

The most common side effects of using DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH are nausea, vomiting, constipation, excessive sleepiness, drowsiness and dizziness, headache, mood changes (high or low), muscle spasms, shortness of breath, dry mouth and excessive sweating. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience excessive drowsiness or breathing difficulties after using this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH Works

DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH is a pain-relieving medication. It works by blocking the transmission of pain signals between the affected sites and the brain which helps in reducing pain sensation.
usageDetails:
How to use DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH

Use DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the skin sites where patch needs to be applied. Carefully peel the shiny plastic backing away from the patch and place the sticky side of the patch onto the skin.

Make sure that the patch sticks well, especially the edges. Wash your hands before and after handling the patch.

Do not use soap, soap or any other cleansers, creams, moisturisers, oils or talc before applying the patch. Do not stick the patch on the skin straight after a hot bath or shower.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration of therapy and skin sites where the patch has to be stuck based on your age, body weight and health condition. Inform your doctor immediately if the patch falls off or tears before it needs changing.

Avoid having long hot baths, hot spa baths, sunbaths or exposing the patch towards direct heat sources (such heating pads, hot-water bottles or heat or tanning lamps) as it may increase the amount of medicine released from the patch. Do not stop using DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH without consulting your doctor.

DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH should be used with caution in patients with low blood pressure or other heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.
DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.
DUROGESIC 50MCG PATCH should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

name: Ibudol Plus Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About IBUDOL PLUS TABLET

IBUDOL PLUS TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. IBUDOL PLUS TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking IBUDOL PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

IBUDOL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

IBUDOL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking IBUDOL PLUS TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of IBUDOL PLUS TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How IBUDOL PLUS TABLET Works

IBUDOL PLUS TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use IBUDOL PLUS TABLET

Take IBUDOL PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take IBUDOL PLUS TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Durogesic 25Mcg Patch 3'S
introduction:
Introduction About DUROGESIC 25MCG PATCH

DUROGESIC 25MCG PATCH contains Fentanyl which belongs to the group of medicine called Opioid Analgesics. It is used to manage severe long-lasting pain. It can also be used in the management of chronic cancer pain and other severe pains that is not controlled by conventional pain killers.

DUROGESIC 25MCG PATCH is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 2 years or above) who need continuous pain management. Before using DUROGESIC 25MCG PATCH inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems.

You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma or any other breathing problems, low blood pressure, mental health problems, chronic alcoholism or a previous history of drug abuse as a precaution.

DUROGESIC 25MCG PATCH is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects. When DUROGESIC 25MCG PATCH is used in children, carefully monitor your child’s health condition. Make sure that they do not peel the patch or accidentally swallow the medicine, as it could lead to fatal outcomes.

Be cautious of storing the medicine strictly out of reach of children. Adults using DUROGESIC 25MCG PATCH should make sure that the medicine is not accidentally stuck to their children or to other family members while coming in close contact.

Repeated or long-term use of DUROGESIC 25MCG PATCH may make the medicine less effective for you as it may make you more dependent on it. Therefore, if you notice that your medicine becomes less effective, consult your doctor.

The most common side effects of using DUROGESIC 25MCG PATCH are nausea, vomiting, constipation, excessive sleepiness, drowsiness and dizziness, headache, mood changes (high or low), muscle spasms, shortness of breath, dry mouth and excessive sweating. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience excessive drowsiness or breathing difficulties after using this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How DUROGESIC 25MCG PATCH Works

DUROGESIC 25MCG PATCH is a pain-relieving medication. It works by blocking the transmission of pain signals between the affected sites and the brain which helps in reducing pain sensation.
usageDetails:
How to use DUROGESIC 25MCG PATCH

Use DUROGESIC 25MCG PATCH as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the skin sites where patch needs to be applied. Carefully peel the shiny plastic backing away from the patch and place the sticky side of the patch onto the skin.

Make sure that the patch sticks well, especially the edges. Wash your hands before and after handling the patch.

Do not use soap, soap or any other cleansers, creams, moisturisers, oils or talc before applying the patch. Do not stick the patch on the skin straight after a hot bath or shower.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration of therapy and skin sites where the patch has to be stuck based on your age, body weight and health condition. Inform your doctor immediately if the patch falls off or tears before it needs changing.

Avoid having long hot baths, hot spa baths, sunbaths or exposing the patch towards direct heat sources (such heating pads, hot-water bottles or heat or tanning lamps) as it may increase the amount of medicine released from the patch. Do not stop using DUROGESIC 25MCG PATCH without consulting your doctor.

DUROGESIC 25MCG PATCH should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

Have acute pain such as surgical pain

Ever had persistent headaches
Recently had a head injury
Suffer from myasthenia gravis (muscle disorder causing severe muscle pain or tenderness)
Have a previous history of drug abuse
Have a habit of smoking
Have any mental health disorders (such as depression, anxiety or a personality disorder) and receiving management for it
Are scheduled for any surgeries in the upcoming days

Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use EXDOL P TABLET

Take EXDOL P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take EXDOL P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

EXDOL P TABLET is not recommended for use during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

EXDOL P TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (which is not adequately controlled by your current medicine)
Known or suspected gastrointestinal obstruction including paralytic ileus

Have epilepsy or already experienced fits or seizures
Have recently suffered from a head injury, shock or severe headaches associated with vomiting
Have intolerance to certain sugars
Have depression

EXDOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

EXDOL P TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About TRAZODAC P TABLET

TRAZODAC P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAZODAC P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking TRAZODAC P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAZODAC P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAZODAC P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About XEROTRAM P TABLET

XEROTRAM P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. XEROTRAM P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking XEROTRAM P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

XEROTRAM P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

XEROTRAM P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking XEROTRAM P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of XEROTRAM P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How XEROTRAM P TABLET Works

XEROTRAM P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

How to use XEROTRAM P TABLET

Take XEROTRAM P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

For effervescent tablet:

Take XEROTRAM P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: TAPENEX ER 100 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About TAPENEX ER 100 TABLET

TAPENEX ER 100 TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPENEX ER 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPENEX ER 100 TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPENEX ER 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPENEX ER 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPENEX ER 100 TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAPENEX ER 100 TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TAPENEX ER 100 TABLET Works

TAPENEX ER 100 TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPENEX ER 100 TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

introduction:
Introduction About FLADOL P TABLET

FLADOL P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. FLADOL P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking FLADOL P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

FLADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

FLADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking FLADOL P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FLADOL P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How FLADOL P TABLET Works

FLADOL P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use FLADOL P TABLET

Take FLADOL P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take FLADOL P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: FLADOL P TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
FLADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel drowsy after taking FLADOL P TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking FLADOL P TABLET because it might make you feel drowsy and it is not recommended for use in patients with acute alcohol poisoning.
FLADOL P TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking FLADOL P TABLET.

FLADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disorder and should be used with caution in patients with liver problems or jaundice. Consult your doctor before taking FLADOL P TABLET.
Do not take FLADOL P TABLET if you are allergic to Paracetamol, Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.
FLADOL P TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have severe difficulties in breathing like asthma or severe lung problems. Consult your doctor before taking FLADOL P TABLET.

Others

FLADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (which is not adequately controlled by your current medicine)
Known or suspected gastrointestinal obstruction including paralytic ileus

Before taking FLADOL P TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have epilepsy or already experienced fits or seizures
Have recently suffered from a head injury, shock or severe headaches associated with vomiting
Have intolerance to certain sugars
Have depression

Use in pediatrics:

FLADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

FLADOL P TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking FLADOL P TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. metoclopramide, domperidone or ondansetron)
Medicines used against infections (Ex. ketoconazole, flucloxacillin, erythromycin)
Medicine used to reduce cholesterol in the blood (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicine used in the management of depression or Parkinson’s disease (Ex. monoamine oxidase inhibitors such as phenelzine, isocarboxazid)  
Amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Medicine used to help stop smoking (Ex. bupropion)
Baclofen (used as muscle relaxant)
Warfarin, phenprocoumon (used to manage or manage blood clots)
Medicine used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine)
Morphine, buprenorphine, nalbuphine or pentazocine (used to manage severe pain)

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of FLADOL P TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of FLADOL P TABLET includes loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, malaise, pallor, excess sweating, respiratory depression and seizures.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION

TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION Works

TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION

TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION.
Do not receive TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

Before receiving TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION to your child. 

Use in geriatrics:

TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMAGESIC 50 INJECTION

Introduction About TRD MD 50MG TABLET

TRD MD 50MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRD MD 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRD MD 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRD MD 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRD MD 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRD MD 50MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRD MD 50MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRD MD 50MG TABLET Works

TRD MD 50MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

Take TRD MD 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About DURAPAIN 30MG CAPSULE

DURAPAIN 30MG CAPSULE is a combination of Diclofenac and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and Opiate analgesics respectively. DURAPAIN 30MG CAPSULE is used in the management of pain and inflammation (redness and swelling). Pain is an unpleasant sensation that occurs with tissue damage. It helps the body to react and manage further tissue damage. It can be short-term (acute) or long-term (chronic) and the perception of pain can differ from one person to other.

Before taking DURAPAIN 30MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gastric bleeding, severe heart failure, high blood pressure, and liver or kidney disease. DURAPAIN 30MG CAPSULE is not recommended in pregnant women, children and adolescents below 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking. DURAPAIN 30MG CAPSULE is excreted into breast milk so it not recommended in breastfeeding women, but if deemed necessary you should stop breast-feeding during the management with DURAPAIN 30MG CAPSULE.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DURAPAIN 30MG CAPSULE because it might make you dizzier. The common side effects of DURAPAIN 30MG CAPSULE nausea, loss of appetite, vomiting, dizziness, indigestion, sleepiness, constipation, heartburn, stomach pain and dryness in the mouth. If any of these side effects become worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

Introduction About DOLONAT TABLET

DOLONAT TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. DOLONAT TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking DOLONAT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

DOLONAT TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

DOLONAT TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking DOLONAT TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

Manage moderate to severe pain

It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

introduction:
Introduction About PAXIN 325MG TABLET

PAXIN 325MG TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. PAXIN 325MG TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking PAXIN 325MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

PAXIN 325MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

PAXIN 325MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking PAXIN 325MG TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PAXIN 325MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How PAXIN 325MG TABLET Works

PAXIN 325MG TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use PAXIN 325MG TABLET

Take PAXIN 325MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take PAXIN 325MG TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NEUTRAM SR 100MG TABLET

NEUTRAM SR 100MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

NEUTRAM SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking NEUTRAM SR 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

NEUTRAM SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. NEUTRAM SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking NEUTRAM SR 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)

How NEUTRAM SR 100MG TABLET Works

NEUTRAM SR 100MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

introduction:
Introduction About ZAMADOL 50MG TABLET

ZAMADOL 50MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

ZAMADOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking ZAMADOL 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

ZAMADOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. ZAMADOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking ZAMADOL 50MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZAMADOL 50MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZAMADOL 50MG TABLET Works

ZAMADOL 50MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use ZAMADOL 50MG TABLET

Take ZAMADOL 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Tramacad P Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TRAMACAD P TABLET

TRAMACAD P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAMACAD P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAMACAD P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMACAD P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMACAD P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMACAD P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMACAD P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMACAD P TABLET Works

TRAMACAD P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMACAD P TABLET

Take TRAMACAD P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAMACAD P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TAPEDAC 100 MG TABLET

TAPEDAC 100 MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPEDAC 100 MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPEDAC 100 MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPEDAC 100 MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPEDAC 100 MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPEDAC 100 MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How TAPEDAC 100 MG TABLET Works

TAPEDAC 100 MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPEDAC 100 MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

introduction:
Introduction About ENZOFLAM TP 325/37.5MG TABLET

ENZOFLAM TP 325/37.5MG TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ENZOFLAM TP 325/37.5MG TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ENZOFLAM TP 325/37.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ENZOFLAM TP 325/37.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ENZOFLAM TP 325/37.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ENZOFLAM TP 325/37.5MG TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ENZOFLAM TP 325/37.5MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ENZOFLAM TP 325/37.5MG TABLET Works

ENZOFLAM TP 325/37.5MG TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ENZOFLAM TP 325/37.5MG TABLET

Take ENZOFLAM TP 325/37.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ENZOFLAM TP 325/37.5MG TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TALNEX 100MG INJECTION

TALNEX 100MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

TALNEX 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving TALNEX 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TALNEX 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TALNEX 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TALNEX 100MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TALNEX 100MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TALNEX 100MG INJECTION Works

TALNEX 100MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TALNEX 100MG INJECTION

TALNEX 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: TALNEX 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women planning to have a baby because the baby may become dependent and may show withdrawal symptoms after the birth. Consult your doctor before receiving TALNEX 100MG INJECTION.
TALNEX 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and will affect the baby. Consult your doctor before receiving TALNEX 100MG INJECTION.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impaired reaction after receiving TALNEX 100MG INJECTION.
Do not consume alcohol while receiving TALNEX 100MG INJECTION as it may increase the effects of this medicine.
TALNEX 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TALNEX 100MG INJECTION.
TALNEX 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TALNEX 100MG INJECTION.
Do not receive TALNEX 100MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

TALNEX 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines)

Before receiving TALNEX 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shock state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

TALNEX 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of TALNEX 100MG INJECTION to your child.

Use in geriatrics:

TALNEX 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving TALNEX 100MG INJECTION.

introduction:
Introduction About MEDOMOL T TABLET

MEDOMOL T TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. MEDOMOL T TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking MEDOMOL T TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

MEDOMOL T TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

MEDOMOL T TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking MEDOMOL T TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEDOMOL T TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How MEDOMOL T TABLET Works

MEDOMOL T TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use MEDOMOL T TABLET

Take MEDOMOL T TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take MEDOMOL T TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: BIOTRAM Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About BIOTRAM INJECTION

BIOTRAM INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

BIOTRAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving BIOTRAM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

BIOTRAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. BIOTRAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving BIOTRAM INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BIOTRAM INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How BIOTRAM INJECTION Works

BIOTRAM INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use BIOTRAM INJECTION

BIOTRAM INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: BIOTRAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women planning to have a baby because the baby may become dependent and may show withdrawal symptoms after the birth. Consult your doctor before receiving BIOTRAM INJECTION.
BIOTRAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and will affect the baby. Consult your doctor before receiving BIOTRAM INJECTION.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impaired reaction after receiving BIOTRAM INJECTION.
Do not consume alcohol while receiving BIOTRAM INJECTION as it may increase the effects of this medicine.
BIOTRAM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving BIOTRAM INJECTION.
BIOTRAM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving BIOTRAM INJECTION.
Do not receive BIOTRAM INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

BIOTRAM INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

Before receiving BIOTRAM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

BIOTRAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of BIOTRAM INJECTION to your child. 

Use in geriatrics:

BIOTRAM INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving BIOTRAM INJECTION

name: TR Plus Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TR PLUS TABLET

TR PLUS TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TR PLUS TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TR PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TR PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TR PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TR PLUS TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TR PLUS TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TR PLUS TABLET Works

TR PLUS TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TR PLUS TABLET

Take TR PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TR PLUS TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About UNIDOL 50MG CAPSULE

UNIDOL 50MG CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

UNIDOL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking UNIDOL 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

UNIDOL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. UNIDOL 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking UNIDOL 50MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of UNIDOL 50MG CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How UNIDOL 50MG CAPSULE Works

UNIDOL 50MG CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

How to use UNIDOL 50MG CAPSULE

Take UNIDOL 50MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: TAPEASE NS Nasal Spray 9ml
introduction:
Introduction About TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY

TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Painkillers. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain post-operatively in patients who are admitted in the hospital.

TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver impairment, lung diseases and no bowel movements.

TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in patients who have increased pressure in the brain, altered consciousness, had head injury, had brain tumour, pancreatic diseases, biliary duct disease, tendency towards fits or tendency of getting habitual to medicines.

TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and breast-feeding women. There is no information on the use of TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY in children, adolescents and elderly patients, hence, ask for your doctor’s advice before using.

The most common side effects of using TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY are nausea, vomiting, headache and fever. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects worsen or doesn’t improve after using TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY.
uses: Manage moderate to severe postoperative pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY
Manage moderate to severe postoperative pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY Works

TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY

Use TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Gently blow and clear the nostrils. Close one nostril by pressing with the help of your finger. Tilt your head slightly forward, keep the bottle of TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY upright and carefully insert the nasal applicator into the other nostril. Press down and release the pump once. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, condition and body weight.

Fever

TAPEASE NS NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). introduction:
Introduction About TROMA 100 INJECTION

TROMA 100 INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

TROMA 100 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving TROMA 100 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TROMA 100 INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TROMA 100 INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TROMA 100 INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TROMA 100 INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TROMA 100 INJECTION Works

TROMA 100 INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TROMA 100 INJECTION

TROMA 100 INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Kamadol P Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About KAMADOL P TABLET

KAMADOL P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. KAMADOL P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking KAMADOL P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

KAMADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

KAMADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking KAMADOL P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of KAMADOL P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How KAMADOL P TABLET Works

KAMADOL P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use KAMADOL P TABLET

Take KAMADOL P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take KAMADOL P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION

TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION Works

TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION

TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION.
Do not receive TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

Before receiving TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION to your child. 

Use in geriatrics:

TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMAZEN 50MG INJECTION

introduction:
Introduction About ULTRAM TABLET

ULTRAM TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ULTRAM TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking ULTRAM TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ULTRAM TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ULTRAM TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ULTRAM TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ULTRAM TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRAM TABLET Works

ULTRAM TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

Take ULTRAM TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ULTRAM TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.
