introduction:
Introduction About ZYROTRAM RAPID TABLET

ZYROTRAM RAPID TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

ZYROTRAM RAPID TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking ZYROTRAM RAPID TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

ZYROTRAM RAPID TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. ZYROTRAM RAPID TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking ZYROTRAM RAPID TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZYROTRAM RAPID TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How ZYROTRAM RAPID TABLET Works

ZYROTRAM RAPID TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About VORTH TP 75MG TABLET

VORTH TP 75MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

VORTH TP 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

VORTH TP 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

VORTH TP 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. VORTH TP 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking VORTH TP 75MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

usesDetails:
Uses Of VORTH TP 75MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How VORTH TP 75MG TABLET Works

VORTH TP 75MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. VORTH TP 75MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

introduction:
Introduction About NEWTAP 75MG TABLET

NEWTAP 75MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

NEWTAP 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

NEWTAP 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

NEWTAP 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. NEWTAP 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking NEWTAP 75MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEWTAP 75MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How NEWTAP 75MG TABLET Works

NEWTAP 75MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. NEWTAP 75MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Take NEWTAP 75MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug–Drug Interactions:

Before taking NEWTAP 75MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Sedatives such as zolpidem, barbiturates (Ex. amobarbital, pentobarbital) antidepressants such as paroxetine, sertraline and anti-psychotics such as loxapine, clozapine, monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) such as isocarboxazid (used to manage depression, anxiety, mood disorders, sleep disturbances) 
Opioids such as codeine, oxymorphone, mixed mu-opioid agonist/antagonists such as pentazocine, nalbuphine, partial mu-opioid agonists such as buprenorphine (used to manage severe pain)
Antihistamines such as cetirizine, loratadine (used to manage allergy)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
St. john’s wort (herbal medicine used to manage depression)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of NEWTAP 75MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of NEWTAP 75MG TABLET are pin-point pupils, vomiting, fast heartbeat, drop in blood pressure, collapse, disturbed consciousness or coma (deep unconsciousness), epileptic fits (convulsions), dangerously slow or shallow breathing or stopping breathing may occur.

name: Traceta Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TRACETA TABLET

TRACETA TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRACETA TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking TRACETA TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRACETA TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRACETA TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRACETA TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRACETA TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRACETA TABLET Works

TRACETA TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRACETA TABLET

Take TRACETA TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRACETA TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: C TOL Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About C TOL INJECTION

C TOL INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

C TOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving C TOL INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

C TOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. C TOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving C TOL INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of C TOL INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How C TOL INJECTION Works

C TOL INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use C TOL INJECTION

C TOL INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

C TOL INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving C TOL INJECTION.

Others

C TOL INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

Before receiving C TOL INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)

C TOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of C TOL INJECTION to your child.

C TOL INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving C TOL INJECTION

name: BUPRIGESIC Patch 2's
introduction:
Introduction About BUPRIGESIC PATCH

BUPRIGESIC PATCH contains Buprenorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Strong analgesics. It is used to provide relief from moderate long-lasting pain that requires the use of a strong painkiller in affected individuals.

Pain is an uncomfortable sensation in the body that stems from the activation of nervous system which generally occurs as an annoying or debilitating sensation generally characterized by symptoms such as as a sharp, dull, throbbing, pinching, stinging and/or burning sensation in affected individuals.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while using BUPRIGESIC PATCH. This medicine is not recommended for use in patients with breathing problems, addiction to drugs and/or myasthenia gravis (condition that weakness muscles). Before using [GNKEYWORD], inform your doctor if you suffer from sleep apnoea (a breathing related sleep disorder), severe liver problems and/or kidney diseases.

BUPRIGESIC PATCH is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

The most common side effects associated with the use of BUPRIGESIC PATCH are headache, dizziness, drowsiness, constipation, nausea, vomiting and itchy skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Provides relief from moderate long-lasting pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of BUPRIGESIC PATCH
Provides relief from moderate long-lasting pain
mechanismOfAction:
How BUPRIGESIC PATCH Works

BUPRIGESIC PATCH works by blocking certain receptors (responsible for pain) in the brain and spinal cord which leads to blockade of pain transmission thus providing relief from moderate and long-lasting pain in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use BUPRIGESIC PATCH

Use BUPRIGESIC PATCH as advised by your physician. Wash and dry the area where the transdermal patch must be placed. Choose a non-irritated, intact skin, relatively hairless or nearly hairless skin area on your upper arm, outer arm, upper chest, upper back, or side of the chest to apply the patch. The sticky side of the patch is protected with a silvery protective foil which is carefully removed without touching the sticky part of the patch. Stick the patch on to the chosen area of the skin and remove the foil.

Press the patch against the skin with your palm and count to 30 seconds slowly. Ensure, the whole patch is in contact with your skin, especially at the edges. The patch should be worn for seven days. Avoid exposing the patch to extreme heat. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

BUPRIGESIC PATCH is not generally recommended for use during pregnancy or in women planning for pregnancy unless it is clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using BUPRIGESIC PATCH.

Breastfeeding

BUPRIGESIC PATCH is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor using BUPRIGESIC PATCH.   

Driving and Using Machines

Do not drive or operate any machines after using BUPRIGESIC PATCH since this medicine may make you feel dizzy, drowsy and/or cause blurred vision which may affect your ability to drive/operate machines. Consult your doctor before using BUPRIGESIC PATCH.  

Alcohol

Avoid consumption of alcohol while using BUPRIGESIC PATCH because it may worsen some of the side effects, make you feel unwell and alter the effect of the medicine. It is not recommended for use in patients with a history of alcohol withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking and/or sweating. It should be used with caution if you or anyone in your family have ever abused or been dependent on alcohol. Consult your doctor before using BUPRIGESIC PATCH.

Kidney

BUPRIGESIC PATCH is used with caution in patients with kidney diseases and in patients who undergo dialysis. Consult your doctor before using BUPRIGESIC PATCH.  

Liver

BUPRIGESIC PATCH should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before using BUPRIGESIC PATCH.   

Allergy

Do not use BUPRIGESIC PATCH if you are allergic to buprenorphine or any other ingredients of this medicine. Consult your doctor before using BUPRIGESIC PATCH.  

Lungs

BUPRIGESIC PATCH is not recommended for use in patients with breathing problems. It should be used with caution in patients with sleep apnoea (breathing related sleep disorder). Consult your doctor before using BUPRIGESIC PATCH.

introduction:
Introduction About DUROGESIC 50MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH

DUROGESIC 50MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH contains Fentanyl which belongs to the group of medicine called Opioid Analgesics. It is used to manage severe long-lasting pain. It can also be used in the management of chronic cancer pain and other severe pains that is not controlled by conventional pain killers.

DUROGESIC 50MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 2 years or above) who need continuous pain management. Before using DUROGESIC 50MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems.

You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma or any other breathing problems, low blood pressure, mental health problems, chronic alcoholism or a previous history of drug abuse as a precaution.

DUROGESIC 50MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects. When DUROGESIC 50MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH is used in children, carefully monitor your child’s health condition. Make sure that they do not peel the patch or accidentally swallow the medicine, as it could lead to fatal outcomes.

Be cautious of storing the medicine strictly out of reach of children. Adults using DUROGESIC 50MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH should make sure that the medicine is not accidentally stuck to their children or to other family members while coming in close contact.

Repeated or long-term use of DUROGESIC 50MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH may make the medicine less effective for you as it may make you more dependent on it. Therefore, if you notice that your medicine becomes less effective, consult your doctor.

The most common side effects of using DUROGESIC 50MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH are nausea, vomiting, constipation, excessive sleepiness, drowsiness and dizziness, headache, mood changes (high or low), muscle spasms, shortness of breath, dry mouth and excessive sweating. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience excessive drowsiness or breathing difficulties after using this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How DUROGESIC 50MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH Works

DUROGESIC 50MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH is a pain-relieving medication. It works by blocking the transmission of pain signals between the affected sites and the brain which helps in reducing pain sensation.
usageDetails:
How to use DUROGESIC 50MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH

Use DUROGESIC 50MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the skin sites where patch needs to be applied. Carefully peel the shiny plastic backing away from the patch and place the sticky side of the patch onto the skin.

Make sure that the patch sticks well, especially the edges. Wash your hands before and after handling the patch.

Do not use soap, soap or any other cleansers, creams, moisturisers, oils or talc before applying the patch. Do not stick the patch on the skin straight after a hot bath or shower.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration of therapy and skin sites where the patch has to be stuck based on your age, body weight and health condition. Inform your doctor immediately if the patch falls off or tears before it needs changing.

Avoid having long hot baths, hot spa baths, sunbaths or exposing the patch towards direct heat sources (such heating pads, hot-water bottles or heat or tanning lamps) as it may increase the amount of medicine released from the patch. Do not stop using DUROGESIC 50MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About STYNAC T TABLET

STYNAC T TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. STYNAC T TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking STYNAC T TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

STYNAC T TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

STYNAC T TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking STYNAC T TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of STYNAC T TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How STYNAC T TABLET Works

STYNAC T TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use STYNAC T TABLET

Take STYNAC T TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take STYNAC T TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRP TABLET

TRP TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRP TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking TRP TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRP TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRP TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRP TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRP TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRP TABLET Works

TRP TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

How to use TRP TABLET

Take TRP TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRP TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About VORTH TP 100MG TABLET

VORTH TP 100MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

VORTH TP 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

VORTH TP 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

VORTH TP 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. VORTH TP 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking VORTH TP 100MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

usesDetails:
Uses Of VORTH TP 100MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How VORTH TP 100MG TABLET Works

VORTH TP 100MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. VORTH TP 100MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Before taking INSTREL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

INSTREL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

INSTREL TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking INSTREL TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

Uses Of INSTREL TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How INSTREL TABLET Works

INSTREL TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use INSTREL TABLET

Take INSTREL TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take INSTREL TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAZODAC FAST 50MG TABLET

TRAZODAC FAST 50MG TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAZODAC FAST 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAZODAC FAST 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAZODAC FAST 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAZODAC FAST 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAZODAC FAST 50MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAZODAC FAST 50MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAZODAC FAST 50MG TABLET Works

TRAZODAC FAST 50MG TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

Take TRAZODAC FAST 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: PROSIA 10 Patch 2's
introduction:
Introduction About PROSIA 10 PATCH

PROSIA 10 Patch contains buprenorphine which belongs to a class of medicines called opioids, which are ‘pain relievers’. This is used to relieve moderate, long-lasting pain that requires the use of a strong painkiller.

Opioids can cause addiction and you may get withdrawal symptoms if you stop taking it suddenly. Your prescriber should have explained how long you will be taking it for and when it is appropriate to stop, how to do this safely.

Alcohol may make some of the side effects worse and you may feel unwell. Prosia 10 Transdermal patches should not be used to relieve acute pain.

Prosia 10 Transdermal patches act through the skin. After application, buprenorphine passes through the skin into the blood. Each patch lasts for seven days.

Do not give this medicine to children below 18 years.  Do not use Prosia 10 Transdermal patches if you are pregnant or breastfeeding or think you may be pregnant unless the benefits of treatment are considered to outweigh the potential harm to the baby.

The most common side effects of Prosia 10 Transdermal patch are headache, dizziness, drowsiness, constipation, feeling or actually being sick, Itchy skin, Rash, and redness.
uses: Manages moderate to severe pain that has not responded to basic painkillers in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of PROSIA 10 PATCH
Manages moderate to severe pain that has not responded to basic painkillers in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How PROSIA 10 PATCH Works

Buprenorphine is an opioid (strong pain reliever), which reduces pain by acting on the central nervous system (specific nerve cells in the spinal cord and in the brain). The effect of the transdermal patch lasts for up to three days. It is not suitable for acute (short-lasting) pain.
usageDetails:
How to use PROSIA 10 PATCH

Always use this medicine exactly as your doctor or pharmacist has told you.  Unless your doctor has told you differently, attach one Prosia 10 Transdermal patch and change it every seventh day, preferably at the same time of day. Your doctor may wish to adjust the dose after 3-7 days until the correct level of pain control has been found. If your doctor has advised you to take other painkillers in addition to the patch, strictly follow the doctor’s instructions,

 You may shower, bathe or swim whilst wearing it. Do not expose the patch to extreme heat (e.g. heating pads, electric blanket, heat lamps, sauna, hot tubs, heated water beds, hot water bottle, etc)

In the unlikely event that your patch falls off before it needs changing, do not use the same patch again. Stick a new one on straight away
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of PROSIA 10 PATCH

Common

• Headache, dizziness, drowsiness.

• Constipation, feeling or actually being sick.

• Itchy skin.

• Rash, redness, itching, inflammation or swelling of the skin at the application site.

• Loss of appetite.

• Confusion, depression, anxiety, difficulty in sleeping, nervousness, shaking (tremors).

• Shortness of breath.

• Abdominal pain or discomfort, diarrhoea, indigestion, dry mouth.

• Sweating, rash, skin eruptions.

• Tiredness, a feeling of unusual weakness, muscle weakness, swelling of hands, ankles or feet.

warnings.details: Do not use Prosia 10 Transdermal patches if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant unless you have discussed this with your prescriber and the benefits of treatment are considered to outweigh the potential harm to the baby.
Do not use Prosia 10 Transdermal patches while you are breastfeeding as buprenorphine passes into breast milk and will affect your baby
Do not drive or operate machines as you may make you feel dizzy or drowsy or experience blurred or double vision
Alcohol may make some of the side effects worse and you may feel unwell if you drink alcohol whilst wearing Prosia 10 Transdermal patches. It may also affect your reaction time.
In patients with kidney disease, no change in dose is necessary.
In patients with liver disease, the effects and period of action of the Prosia 10 Transdermal patch may be affected and your doctor will therefore check on you more closely.
Do not use Prosia 10 Transdermal patches if you are allergic to buprenorphine or any other ingredients of this medicine.
Prosia 10 Transdermal patches should not be used in patients below the age of 18 years.
No dosage adjustment is needed for elderly patients.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAZODAC INJECTION

TRAZODAC INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

TRAZODAC INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving TRAZODAC INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRAZODAC INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TRAZODAC INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRAZODAC INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAZODAC INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAZODAC INJECTION Works

TRAZODAC INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAZODAC INJECTION

TRAZODAC INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Tend to develop fits

introduction:
Introduction About DOLODOL P 325/37.5MG TABLET

DOLODOL P 325/37.5MG TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. DOLODOL P 325/37.5MG TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking DOLODOL P 325/37.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

DOLODOL P 325/37.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

DOLODOL P 325/37.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking DOLODOL P 325/37.5MG TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOLODOL P 325/37.5MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How DOLODOL P 325/37.5MG TABLET Works

DOLODOL P 325/37.5MG TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use DOLODOL P 325/37.5MG TABLET

Take DOLODOL P 325/37.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take DOLODOL P 325/37.5MG TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TROFENTYL 50MCG INJECTION

TROFENTYL 50MCG INJECTION contains Fentanyl which belongs to the group of medicine called Opioid Analgesics. It is used in the management of severe pain. It provides pain relief during and after short surgical procedures.

During major surgical procedures, it is commonly used prior to and along with certain anesthetics (Ex. halothane, sevoflurane) and neuroleptic medicines to induce and maintain anesthesia (loss of sensation) and/or pain relief. It is frequently used to supplement anaesthetics which permits the use of anaesthetic at low doses.

Before receiving TROFENTYL 50MCG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma or any other breathing problems, muscle weakness, thyroid deficiency, severe undiagnosed headaches, alcoholism or a previous history of drug abuse as a precaution.

If you are currently taking or recently took any sleeping pills or medicines used for depression, make sure to inform your doctor before TROFENTYL 50MCG INJECTION is given to you.

The most common side effects of receiving TROFENTYL 50MCG INJECTION are pain and swelling at the site of injection, nausea, vomiting, muscle stiffness, headache, dizziness, drowsiness, low blood pressure, blurred vision, low pulse, wheezing or breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION

TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION Works

TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION

TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION.
Do not receive TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

Before receiving TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION to your child. 

Use in geriatrics:

TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMADOL(THEMIS) INJECTION

Introduction About TDX 50 INJECTION

TDX 50 INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TDX 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TDX 50 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TDX 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TDX 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TDX 50 INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TDX 50 INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TDX 50 INJECTION Works

TDX 50 INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TDX 50 INJECTION

TDX 50 INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: TRAMAZIDE D Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAZIDE D TABLET

TRAMAZIDE D TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and Opiate analgesics respectively. TRAMAZIDE D TABLET is used in the management of pain and inflammation (redness and swelling). Pain is an unpleasant sensation that occurs with tissue damage. It helps the body to react and manage further tissue damage. It can be short-term (acute) or long-term (chronic) and the perception of pain can differ from one person to other.

Before taking TRAMAZIDE D TABLET, inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gastric bleeding, severe heart failure, high blood pressure, and liver or kidney disease. TRAMAZIDE D TABLET is not recommended in pregnant women, children and adolescents below 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking. TRAMAZIDE D TABLET is excreted into breast milk so it not recommended in breastfeeding women, but if deemed necessary you should stop breast-feeding during the management with TRAMAZIDE D TABLET.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TRAMAZIDE D TABLET because it might make you dizzier. The common side effects of TRAMAZIDE D TABLET nausea, loss of appetite, vomiting, dizziness, indigestion, sleepiness, constipation, heartburn, stomach pain and dryness in the mouth. If any of these side effects become worsen, contact your doctor for advice.
uses: Used to manage pain and inflammation (redness and swelling)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAZIDE D TABLET
Used to manage pain and inflammation (redness and swelling)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAZIDE D TABLET Works

TRAMAZIDE D TABLET contains Diclofenac and Tramadol. Diclofenac works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system which blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.

How to use TRAMAZIDE D TABLET

Take TRAMAZIDE D TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

name: TP CARE Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TP CARE TABLET

TP CARE TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TP CARE TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TP CARE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TP CARE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TP CARE TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TP CARE TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TP CARE TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TP CARE TABLET Works

TP CARE TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TP CARE TABLET

Take TP CARE TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TP CARE TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

usesDetails:

Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRANZEX 50MG INJECTION Works

TRANZEX 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

TRANZEX 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

TRANZEX 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)

TRANZEX 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving TRANZEX 50MG INJECTION

name: Zoftadol Plus Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZOFTADOL PLUS TABLET

ZOFTADOL PLUS TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ZOFTADOL PLUS TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ZOFTADOL PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ZOFTADOL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ZOFTADOL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ZOFTADOL PLUS TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOFTADOL PLUS TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOFTADOL PLUS TABLET Works

ZOFTADOL PLUS TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ZOFTADOL PLUS TABLET

Take ZOFTADOL PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ZOFTADOL PLUS TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Trapidol 100mg Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION

TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION Works

TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION

TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION.
TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION.
Do not receive TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines)

Before receiving TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shock state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION to your child.

Use in geriatrics:

TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving TRAPIDOL 100MG INJECTION.

name: Buprigesic Injection 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About BUPRIGESIC INJECTION

BUPRIGESIC INJECTION contains Buprenorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioid Analgesics. It is used to provide relief from moderate to severe pain in affected individuals.

Pain is an uncomfortable sensation in the body that stems from the activation of the nervous system which generally occurs as an annoying/debilitating sensation, characterized by symptoms such as sharp, dull, throbbing, pinching, stinging, and/or burning sensation in the affected individuals.  

It is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Buprenorphine or other opiates (having morphine-like action). Before receiving BUPRIGESIC INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have breathing problems, suffer from fit/seizures, depression, renal impairment, liver problems or had undergone cardiac surgery.       

Opioids can lead to addiction, particularly when used for a long period of time and it may cause withdrawal symptoms (such as restlessness, difficulty sleeping, irritability, agitation, palpitation, etc.) when stop receiving this medicine suddenly.

BUPRIGESIC INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, including infants (aged below 6 months). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving BUPRIGESIC INJECTION. 

The common side effects associated with the use of BUPRIGESIC INJECTION are constipation, headache, nausea, urinary retention and sedation. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About DOLOSPAN P FIZZ TABLET

DOLOSPAN P FIZZ TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. DOLOSPAN P FIZZ TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking DOLOSPAN P FIZZ TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

DOLOSPAN P FIZZ TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

DOLOSPAN P FIZZ TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking DOLOSPAN P FIZZ TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOLOSPAN P FIZZ TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How DOLOSPAN P FIZZ TABLET Works

DOLOSPAN P FIZZ TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use DOLOSPAN P FIZZ TABLET

Take DOLOSPAN P FIZZ TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take DOLOSPAN P FIZZ TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About DIBOL LD TABLET

DIBOL LD TABLET is used in the management of pain and inflammation (redness and swelling). Pain is an unpleasant sensation that occurs with tissue damage. It helps the body to react and manage further tissue damage. It can be short-term (acute) or long-term (chronic) and the perception of pain can differ from one person to other.

Before taking DIBOL LD TABLET, inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gastric bleeding, severe heart failure, high blood pressure, and liver or kidney disease. DIBOL LD TABLET is excreted into breast milk so it not recommended in breastfeeding women, but if deemed necessary you should stop breast-feeding during the management with DIBOL LD TABLET.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DIBOL LD TABLET because it might make you dizzier. The common side effects of DIBOL LD TABLET nausea, loss of appetite, vomiting, dizziness, indigestion, sleepiness, constipation, heartburn, stomach pain and dryness in the mouth. If any of these side effects become worsen, contact your doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION

TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION Works

TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION

TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and will affect the baby. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impaired reaction after receiving TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION.
Do not consume alcohol while receiving TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION as it may increase the effects of this medicine.
TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION.
TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION.
Do not receive TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

Before receiving TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION to your child. 

Use in geriatrics:

TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMACIP 50MG INJECTION

Carbamazepine (used to manage fits)
Ondansetron (used to manage or manage nausea)
Monoamine oxidase inhibitors (medicines used to manage depression) Ex. moclobemide, phenelzine and selegiline (used to manage Parkinson's disease)

introduction:
Introduction About BUPRINOR INJECTION

BUPRINOR INJECTION contains Buprenorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioid Analgesics. It is used to provide relief from moderate to severe pain in affected individuals.

Pain is an uncomfortable sensation in the body that stems from the activation of the nervous system which generally occurs as an annoying/debilitating sensation, characterized by symptoms such as sharp, dull, throbbing, pinching, stinging, and/or burning sensation in the affected individuals.  

It is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Buprenorphine or other opiates (having morphine-like action). Before receiving BUPRINOR INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have breathing problems, suffer from fit/seizures, depression, renal impairment, liver problems or had undergone cardiac surgery.       

Opioids can lead to addiction, particularly when used for a long period of time and it may cause withdrawal symptoms (such as restlessness, difficulty sleeping, irritability, agitation, palpitation, etc.) when stop receiving this medicine suddenly.

BUPRINOR INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, including infants (aged below 6 months). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving BUPRINOR INJECTION. 

The common side effects associated with the use of BUPRINOR INJECTION are constipation, headache, nausea, urinary retention and sedation. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How BUPRINOR INJECTION Works

BUPRINOR INJECTION works by blocking certain receptors (responsible for pain) in the brain and spinal cord which leads to the blockade of pain transmission thus providing relief from moderate/severe pain in affected individuals.

BUPRINOR INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein as a slow intravenous injection or into the muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: SPASMO PROXYVON T+ Capsule 8's
introduction:
Introduction About SPASMO PROXYVON T+ CAPSULE

SPASMO PROXYVON T+ CAPSULE contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

SPASMO PROXYVON T+ CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

SPASMO PROXYVON T+ CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

SPASMO PROXYVON T+ CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. SPASMO PROXYVON T+ CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking SPASMO PROXYVON T+ CAPSULE are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of SPASMO PROXYVON T+ CAPSULE
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How SPASMO PROXYVON T+ CAPSULE Works

SPASMO PROXYVON T+ CAPSULE acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. SPASMO PROXYVON T+ CAPSULE binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Take SPASMO PROXYVON T+ CAPSULE as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TAPRISE NS NASAL SPRAY

TAPRISE NS NASAL SPRAY contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Painkillers. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain post-operatively in patients who are admitted in the hospital.

TAPRISE NS NASAL SPRAY is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver impairment, lung diseases and no bowel movements.

TAPRISE NS NASAL SPRAY should be used with caution in patients who have increased pressure in the brain, altered consciousness, had head injury, had brain tumour, pancreatic diseases, biliary duct disease, tendency towards fits or tendency of getting habitual to medicines.

TAPRISE NS NASAL SPRAY should not be used in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and breast-feeding women. There is no information on the use of TAPRISE NS NASAL SPRAY in children, adolescents and elderly patients, hence, ask for your doctor’s advice before using.

The most common side effects of using TAPRISE NS NASAL SPRAY are nausea, vomiting, headache and fever. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects worsen or doesn’t improve after using TAPRISE NS NASAL SPRAY.
uses: Manage moderate to severe postoperative pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAPRISE NS NASAL SPRAY
Manage moderate to severe postoperative pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TAPRISE NS NASAL SPRAY Works

TAPRISE NS NASAL SPRAY acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPRISE NS NASAL SPRAY binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use TAPRISE NS NASAL SPRAY

Use TAPRISE NS NASAL SPRAY as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Gently blow and clear the nostrils. Close one nostril by pressing with the help of your finger. Tilt your head slightly forward, keep the bottle of TAPRISE NS NASAL SPRAY upright and carefully insert the nasal applicator into the other nostril. Press down and release the pump once. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, condition and body weight.

Fever

FORTWIN INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women until necessary, therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it. FORTWIN INJECTION is not recommended for administration in children and adolescents less than 12 years of age, consult your doctor for advice. FORTWIN INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, therefore consult your doctor before receiving. The most common side effects after receiving FORTWIN INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, sedation, sweating, dizziness, euphoria and light-headedness. Consult your doctor immediately in case any of the side effects worsen or you experience an allergic reaction after receiving FORTWIN INJECTION.
