Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving FORTWIN INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Zolpidem, estazolam (medicines used for the management of sleep disorders)
Anxiolytics and tranquillizers such as alprazolam, chlordiazepoxide (medicines used for the management of anxiety disorders)
Muscle relaxants such as chlorzoxazone, metaxalone (medicines used for muscle relaxation and management of muscle pain)
General anaesthetics such as isoflurane, propofol (medicines used during major surgeries for pain management)
Haloperidol, trifluoperazine and phenothiazines such as chlorpromazine (medicines used for the management of schizophrenia)
Antihistamines such as cetirizine, levocetirizine (medicines used for the management of allergic conditions)
Antiemetics such as ondansetron, dolasetron (medicines used for the management of vomiting)
Beta-blockers (medicines used for the management of high blood pressure)
Monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) such as selegiline, phenelzine (medicines used for the management of depression and mood disorders)
Opiate agonists such as methadone, morphine (medicines used for the management of moderate to severe pain)
Diuretics such as spironolactone, amiloride, frusemide (medicines used for the management of high blood pressure and oedema)
Hyoscyamine, Glycopyrrolate (medicines used for the management of various problems such as urinary incontinence, overactive bladder (OAB), chronic obstructive pulmonary disorder (COPD), certain types of poisoning)
Citalopram, fluoxetine (medicines used for the management of depression)
Mixed agonist/antagonist and partial agonist opioid analgesics such as butorphanol, nalbuphine, buprenorphine (medicines used for the management of moderate to severe pain)
Medicines used to manage migraines such as triptans
St. John's Wort (herbal medicine)

Overdosage:

FORTWIN INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse immediately in case you experience any unusual symptoms. Symptoms of overdose are somnolence, respiratory depression, low or high blood pressure, increased heartbeat, hallucinations or seizures.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMATAS PLUS 325/37.5MG TABLET

TRAMATAS PLUS 325/37.5MG TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAMATAS PLUS 325/37.5MG TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAMATAS PLUS 325/37.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMATAS PLUS 325/37.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMATAS PLUS 325/37.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMATAS PLUS 325/37.5MG TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMATAS PLUS 325/37.5MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMATAS PLUS 325/37.5MG TABLET Works

TRAMATAS PLUS 325/37.5MG TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMATAS PLUS 325/37.5MG TABLET

Take TRAMATAS PLUS 325/37.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAMATAS PLUS 325/37.5MG TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION

NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION Works

NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION

NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women planning to have a baby because the baby may become dependent and may show withdrawal symptoms after the birth. Consult your doctor before receiving NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION.

NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and will affect the baby. Consult your doctor before receiving NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION.

Do not consume alcohol while receiving NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION as it may increase the effects of this medicine.
NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION.
NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION.
Do not receive NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines)

Before receiving NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shock state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION to your child.

Use in geriatrics:

NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving NOBLIGAN 100MG INJECTION.

introduction:
Introduction About PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE

PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE Works

PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

Take PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take PROXYVON PLUS CAPSULE by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NORPHIN

NORPHIN contains Buprenorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioid Analgesics. It is used to provide relief from moderate to severe pain in affected individuals.

Pain is an uncomfortable sensation in the body that stems from the activation of the nervous system which generally occurs as an annoying/debilitating sensation, characterized by symptoms such as sharp, dull, throbbing, pinching, stinging, and/or burning sensation in the affected individuals.  

It is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Buprenorphine or other opiates (having morphine-like action). Before receiving NORPHIN, inform your doctor if you have breathing problems, suffer from fit/seizures, depression, renal impairment, liver problems or had undergone cardiac surgery.       

Opioids can lead to addiction, particularly when used for a long period of time and it may cause withdrawal symptoms (such as restlessness, difficulty sleeping, irritability, agitation, palpitation, etc.) when stop receiving this medicine suddenly.

NORPHIN is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, including infants (aged below 6 months). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving NORPHIN. 

The common side effects associated with the use of NORPHIN are constipation, headache, nausea, urinary retention and sedation. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Provides relief from moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How NORPHIN Works

NORPHIN works by blocking certain receptors (responsible for pain) in the brain and spinal cord which leads to the blockade of pain transmission thus providing relief from moderate/severe pain in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use NORPHIN

NORPHIN will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein as a slow intravenous injection or into the muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

NORPHIN should be used with caution in patients who had undergone cardiac surgery. Consult your doctor before receiving NORPHIN.

introduction:
Introduction About ULTRACET SEMI TABLET

ULTRACET SEMI TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ULTRACET SEMI TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking ULTRACET SEMI TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ULTRACET SEMI TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ULTRACET SEMI TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ULTRACET SEMI TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ULTRACET SEMI TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRACET SEMI TABLET Works

ULTRACET SEMI TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRACET SEMI TABLET

Take ULTRACET SEMI TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ULTRACET SEMI TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DOLOSPAN 100MG INJECTION

DOLOSPAN 100MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

DOLOSPAN 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving DOLOSPAN 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

DOLOSPAN 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. DOLOSPAN 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving DOLOSPAN 100MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOLOSPAN 100MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How DOLOSPAN 100MG INJECTION Works

DOLOSPAN 100MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use DOLOSPAN 100MG INJECTION

DOLOSPAN 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About BUPRIGESIC INJECTION

BUPRIGESIC INJECTION contains Buprenorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioid Analgesics. It is used to provide relief from moderate to severe pain in affected individuals.

Pain is an uncomfortable sensation in the body that stems from the activation of the nervous system which generally occurs as an annoying/debilitating sensation, characterized by symptoms such as sharp, dull, throbbing, pinching, stinging, and/or burning sensation in the affected individuals.  

It is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Buprenorphine or other opiates (having morphine-like action). Before receiving BUPRIGESIC INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have breathing problems, suffer from fit/seizures, depression, renal impairment, liver problems or had undergone cardiac surgery.       

Opioids can lead to addiction, particularly when used for a long period of time and it may cause withdrawal symptoms (such as restlessness, difficulty sleeping, irritability, agitation, palpitation, etc.) when stop receiving this medicine suddenly.

BUPRIGESIC INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, including infants (aged below 6 months). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving BUPRIGESIC INJECTION. 

The common side effects associated with the use of BUPRIGESIC INJECTION are constipation, headache, nausea, urinary retention and sedation. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How BUPRIGESIC INJECTION Works

BUPRIGESIC INJECTION works by blocking certain receptors (responsible for pain) in the brain and spinal cord which leads to the blockade of pain transmission thus providing relief from moderate/severe pain in affected individuals.

BUPRIGESIC INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein as a slow intravenous injection or into the muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ZAMADOL P TABLET

ZAMADOL P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ZAMADOL P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ZAMADOL P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ZAMADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ZAMADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ZAMADOL P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZAMADOL P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ZAMADOL P TABLET Works

ZAMADOL P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ZAMADOL P TABLET

Take ZAMADOL P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ZAMADOL P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Vorth TP 50mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About VORTH TP 50MG TABLET

VORTH TP 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

VORTH TP 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

VORTH TP 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

VORTH TP 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. VORTH TP 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking VORTH TP 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of VORTH TP 50MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How VORTH TP 50MG TABLET Works

VORTH TP 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. VORTH TP 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

introduction:
Introduction About ULTRAM 100MG INJECTION

ULTRAM 100MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

ULTRAM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving ULTRAM 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

ULTRAM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. ULTRAM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving ULTRAM 100MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ULTRAM 100MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRAM 100MG INJECTION Works

ULTRAM 100MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRAM 100MG INJECTION

ULTRAM 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

ULTRAM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines)

Before receiving ULTRAM 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shock state (cold sweat may be a sign)

introduction:
Introduction About DOL PROXYVON SR 75MG CAPSULE

DOL PROXYVON SR 75MG CAPSULE contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

DOL PROXYVON SR 75MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

DOL PROXYVON SR 75MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

DOL PROXYVON SR 75MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. DOL PROXYVON SR 75MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking DOL PROXYVON SR 75MG CAPSULE are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOL PROXYVON SR 75MG CAPSULE
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How DOL PROXYVON SR 75MG CAPSULE Works

DOL PROXYVON SR 75MG CAPSULE acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. DOL PROXYVON SR 75MG CAPSULE binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Take DOL PROXYVON SR 75MG CAPSULE as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have lactose intolerance

DOL PROXYVON SR 75MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking DOL PROXYVON SR 75MG CAPSULE.

name: G Dol Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About G DOL CAPSULE

G DOL CAPSULE is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. G DOL CAPSULE is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking G DOL CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

G DOL CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

G DOL CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking G DOL CAPSULE are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of G DOL CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How G DOL CAPSULE Works

G DOL CAPSULE contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use G DOL CAPSULE

Take G DOL CAPSULE as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take G DOL CAPSULE by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NEUTRAM 50MG INJECTION

NEUTRAM 50MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

NEUTRAM 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving NEUTRAM 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

NEUTRAM 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. NEUTRAM 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving NEUTRAM 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEUTRAM 50MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How NEUTRAM 50MG INJECTION Works

NEUTRAM 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use NEUTRAM 50MG INJECTION

NEUTRAM 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

NEUTRAM 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

Before receiving NEUTRAM 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

NEUTRAM 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). Introduction About ASQUE DUO TABLET

ASQUE DUO TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ASQUE DUO TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ASQUE DUO TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ASQUE DUO TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ASQUE DUO TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ASQUE DUO TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

Uses Of ASQUE DUO TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ASQUE DUO TABLET Works

ASQUE DUO TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ASQUE DUO TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About TRAMADEX INJECTION

TRAMADEX INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TRAMADEX INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TRAMADEX INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRAMADEX INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRAMADEX INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRAMADEX INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMADEX INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMADEX INJECTION Works

TRAMADEX INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

TRAMADEX INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

TRAMADEX INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMADEX INJECTION.
Do not receive TRAMADEX INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

TRAMADEX INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

Before receiving TRAMADEX INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shocking state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

TRAMADEX INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of TRAMADEX INJECTION to your child.

TRAMADEX INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMADEX INJECTION

introduction:
Introduction About ULTRAMED D TABLET

ULTRAMED D TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ULTRAMED D TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking ULTRAMED D TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ULTRAMED D TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ULTRAMED D TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRAMED D TABLET Works

ULTRAMED D TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

introduction:
Introduction About DOLOPENT INJECTION

DOLOPENT INJECTION contains Pentazocine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opiate Analgesics. DOLOPENT INJECTION is used to relieve moderate to severe pain. It may also be used for pre-operative or pre-anesthetic medication and as a supplement to surgical anesthesia. Avoid consuming alcohol, tobacco, and smoking while receiving DOLOPENT INJECTION as it can increase the side effects.

Do not receive DOLOPENT INJECTION if you have severe asthma, trouble breathing, or other breathing problems, heart problems, bowel blockage or narrowing of the stomach or intestines, severe pain in the abdomen due to acute appendicitis or pancreatitis, acute respiratory depression, head injury, a risk for seizures, undergone a surgery or are planned to undergo a surgery therefore, consult your doctor before receiving. DOLOPENT INJECTION should be used with caution in patients who have severe kidney, liver and lung disease, heart disease, migraines, chronic or severe constipation, thyroid, adrenal or prostate gland disorders, low blood pressure, psychiatric problems such as depression, hallucinations or other mental problems, consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

DOLOPENT INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women until necessary, therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it. DOLOPENT INJECTION is not recommended for administration in children and adolescents less than 12 years of age, consult your doctor for advice. DOLOPENT INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, therefore consult your doctor before receiving. The most common side effects after receiving DOLOPENT INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, sedation, sweating, dizziness, euphoria and light-headedness. Consult your doctor immediately in case any of the side effects worsen or you experience an allergic reaction after receiving DOLOPENT INJECTION.

Introduction About TRAMANAM 50MG INJECTION

TRAMANAM 50MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TRAMANAM 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TRAMANAM 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRAMANAM 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRAMANAM 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRAMANAM 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMANAM 50MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMANAM 50MG INJECTION Works

TRAMANAM 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

TRAMANAM 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: FENDROP Injection 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About FENDROP INJECTION

FENDROP INJECTION contains Fentanyl which belongs to the group of medicine called Opioid Analgesics. It is used in the management of severe pain. It provides pain relief during and after short surgical procedures.

During major surgical procedures, it is commonly used prior to and along with certain anesthetics (Ex. halothane, sevoflurane) and neuroleptic medicines to induce and maintain anesthesia (loss of sensation) and/or pain relief. It is frequently used to supplement anaesthetics which permits the use of anaesthetic at low doses.

Before receiving FENDROP INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma or any other breathing problems, muscle weakness, thyroid deficiency, severe undiagnosed headaches, alcoholism or a previous history of drug abuse as a precaution.

If you are currently taking or recently took any sleeping pills or medicines used for depression, make sure to inform your doctor before FENDROP INJECTION is given to you.

The most common side effects of receiving FENDROP INJECTION are pain and swelling at the site of injection, nausea, vomiting, muscle stiffness, headache, dizziness, drowsiness, low blood pressure, blurred vision, low pulse, wheezing or breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How FENDROP INJECTION Works

FENDROP INJECTION is a pain-relieving medication. It works by blocking the transmission of pain signals between the affected sites and the brain which helps in reducing pain sensation.

FENDROP INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously). Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TAMFLAM 100MG INJECTION

TAMFLAM 100MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

TAMFLAM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving TAMFLAM 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TAMFLAM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TAMFLAM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TAMFLAM 100MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAMFLAM 100MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TAMFLAM 100MG INJECTION Works

TAMFLAM 100MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

NEXDOL 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving NEXDOL 100MG INJECTION.
NEXDOL 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving NEXDOL 100MG INJECTION.
Do not receive NEXDOL 100MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

NEXDOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines)

Before receiving NEXDOL 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shock state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

NEXDOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of NEXDOL 100MG INJECTION to your child.

Use in geriatrics:

NEXDOL 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving NEXDOL 100MG INJECTION.

name: Ultraniche Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ULTRANICHE TABLET

ULTRANICHE TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ULTRANICHE TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking ULTRANICHE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ULTRANICHE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ULTRANICHE TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ULTRANICHE TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ULTRANICHE TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRANICHE TABLET Works

ULTRANICHE TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRANICHE TABLET

Take ULTRANICHE TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ULTRANICHE TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About ZOFTADOL INJECTION

ZOFTADOL INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

ZOFTADOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving ZOFTADOL INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

ZOFTADOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. ZOFTADOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving ZOFTADOL INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZOFTADOL INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ZOFTADOL INJECTION Works

ZOFTADOL INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use ZOFTADOL INJECTION

ZOFTADOL INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: DOL Proxyvon ER 100mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About DOL PROXYVON ER 100MG TABLET

DOL PROXYVON ER 100MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

DOL PROXYVON ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

DOL PROXYVON ER 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

DOL PROXYVON ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. DOL PROXYVON ER 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking DOL PROXYVON ER 100MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOL PROXYVON ER 100MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How DOL PROXYVON ER 100MG TABLET Works

DOL PROXYVON ER 100MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. DOL PROXYVON ER 100MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use DOL PROXYVON ER 100MG TABLET

Take DOL PROXYVON ER 100MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About TRD CONJECT INJECTION

TRD CONJECT INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TRD CONJECT INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TRD CONJECT INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRD CONJECT INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRD CONJECT INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRD CONJECT INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRD CONJECT INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRD CONJECT INJECTION Works

TRD CONJECT INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRD CONJECT INJECTION

TRD CONJECT INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

mechanismOfAction:
How TRUMP 100MG INJECTION Works

TRUMP 100MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Avoid consuming alcohol, tobacco, and smoking while receiving PENTAWOK INJECTION as it can increase the side effects.

Do not receive PENTAWOK INJECTION if you have severe asthma, trouble breathing, or other breathing problems, heart problems, bowel blockage or narrowing of the stomach or intestines, severe pain in the abdomen due to acute appendicitis or pancreatitis, acute respiratory depression, head injury, a risk for seizures, undergone a surgery or are planned to undergo a surgery therefore, consult your doctor before receiving. PENTAWOK INJECTION should be used with caution in patients who have severe kidney, liver and lung disease, heart disease, migraines, chronic or severe constipation, thyroid, adrenal or prostate gland disorders, low blood pressure, psychiatric problems such as depression, hallucinations or other mental problems, consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

PENTAWOK INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women until necessary, therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it. PENTAWOK INJECTION is not recommended for administration in children and adolescents less than 12 years of age, consult your doctor for advice. PENTAWOK INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, therefore consult your doctor before receiving. The most common side effects after receiving PENTAWOK INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, sedation, sweating, dizziness, euphoria and light-headedness. Consult your doctor immediately in case any of the side effects worsen or you experience an allergic reaction after receiving PENTAWOK INJECTION.

ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioid analgesics. It is indicated to manage moderate to severe pain. Pain is an uncomfortable sensory and emotional experience associated with or resembling actual or potential tissue damage. It is always a personal experience that depends on various biological, psychological and social factors.

Your doctor will manage you with ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY for short periods with regular breaks to minimise the risk of developing dependence.

ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY is not recommended for use in patients having epilepsy (fits) which is not controlled with management, in acute poisoning with medicines that affect mood and emotions and as a substitute in the management of drug withdrawal.

Before using ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY, inform your doctor if you have a head injury, breathing difficulties, any consciousness disorders, severe kidney and liver problems or addiction to any painkillers.

ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY should be used in pregnant women only if your doctor finds it necessary and it is not recommended for use in breast feeding mothers more than once. ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY is not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age and those with breathing problems. ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY should be used with caution among elderly people.

The most common side effects of using ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, constipation and sweating. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects deteriorate.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY Works

ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY

Always use ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY as directed by the physician. It is for rectal use only. It must be inserted deep into the back passage (rectum) as directed by your doctor. For easy insertion, you can either warm the medicine up in your hands or briefly dip it in hot water. Your doctor will give an appropriate dose of ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY depending on your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

warnings.details: ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. You should not use ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY for long-term during pregnancy as it may affect your unborn child who may develop withdrawal symptoms. Consult your doctor before using it.
ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women more than once as it is excreted into breast milk. Consult your doctor before using it.
Do not drive or operate any machines after using ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY as it may cause drowsiness, dizziness and blurred vision and thus impair your reactions.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while using ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY as it may increase its effects and make you feel drowsier or feel that you may faint.

ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney insufficiency and your doctor might prolong your dosage interval if you have mild or moderate kidney insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Consult your doctor before using it.

ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver insufficiency and your doctor might prolong your dosage interval if you have mild or moderate liver insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before using it.
Do not use ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY if you are allergic to Tramadol or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY should be used with caution in patients having breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor before using it.

Others

ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not controlled by management
Have acute poisoning with medicines that affect mood and emotions (Ex. painkillers, sleeping pills or other psychotropic medicines)
Are using it as a substitute in drug withdrawal management

Before using ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY, inform your doctor if you:

Have a tendency for epilepsy or seizures (fits)
Have a head injury
Have abnormal pressure inside the skull, occuring as a result of any head injury, brain disease or brain tumour
Are suffering from shock (signs include cold sweats)
Are suffering from consciousness disorders such as fainting
Think that you have addiction to other painkillers (opioids)

Use in paediatrics:

ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and in children having breathing problems. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years) as the excretion of this medicine may be delayed. Consult your doctor before using it.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before using ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Certain medicines used to manage depression (Ex. isocarboxazid, phenelzine, fluoxetine, paroxetine)

Medicines used to manage pain (Ex. pentazocine, nalbuphine, buprenorphine)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally insert too much of ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of ZYROTRAM SUPPOSITORY overdose includes pin-point pupils, vomiting, drop in blood pressure, fast heartbeat, disturbed consciousness, epileptic fits and difficulty in breathing.

introduction:
Introduction About DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET

DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET Works

DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET

Take DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not take DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET if you are allergic to Tapentadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). It should be used with caution in patients having other breathing issues (slow or shallow breathing). Consult your doctor before taking DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET.

Others

DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Before taking DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

Use in paediatrics:

DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.     

 Use in geriatrics:

DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking DOL PROXYVON 75MG TABLET.

name: BUPRESPLAST 10 Patch 1's
introduction:
Introduction About BUPRESPLAST 10 PATCH

BUPRESPLAST 10 PATCH contains Buprenorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Strong analgesics. It is used to provide relief from moderate long-lasting pain that requires the use of a strong painkiller in affected individuals.

Pain is an uncomfortable sensation in the body that stems from the activation of nervous system which generally occurs as an annoying or debilitating sensation generally characterized by symptoms such as as a sharp, dull, throbbing, pinching, stinging and/or burning sensation in affected individuals.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while using BUPRESPLAST 10 PATCH. This medicine is not recommended for use in patients with breathing problems, addiction to drugs and/or myasthenia gravis (condition that weakness muscles). Before using [GNKEYWORD], inform your doctor if you suffer from sleep apnoea (a breathing related sleep disorder), severe liver problems and/or kidney diseases.

BUPRESPLAST 10 PATCH is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

The most common side effects associated with the use of BUPRESPLAST 10 PATCH are headache, dizziness, drowsiness, constipation, nausea, vomiting and itchy skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Provides relief from moderate long-lasting pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of BUPRESPLAST 10 PATCH
Provides relief from moderate long-lasting pain
mechanismOfAction:
How BUPRESPLAST 10 PATCH Works

BUPRESPLAST 10 PATCH works by blocking certain receptors (responsible for pain) in the brain and spinal cord which leads to blockade of pain transmission thus providing relief from moderate and long-lasting pain in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use BUPRESPLAST 10 PATCH

Use BUPRESPLAST 10 PATCH as advised by your physician. Wash and dry the area where the transdermal patch must be placed. Choose a non-irritated, intact skin, relatively hairless or nearly hairless skin area on your upper arm, outer arm, upper chest, upper back, or side of the chest to apply the patch. The sticky side of the patch is protected with a silvery protective foil which is carefully removed without touching the sticky part of the patch. Stick the patch on to the chosen area of the skin and remove the foil.

Press the patch against the skin with your palm and count to 30 seconds slowly. Ensure, the whole patch is in contact with your skin, especially at the edges. The patch should be worn for seven days. Avoid exposing the patch to extreme heat. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: MERIDOL Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About MERIDOL TABLET

MERIDOL TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. MERIDOL TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking MERIDOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

MERIDOL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

MERIDOL TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking MERIDOL TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MERIDOL TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How MERIDOL TABLET Works

MERIDOL TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use MERIDOL TABLET

Take MERIDOL TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take MERIDOL TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CENTRADOL 100MG INJECTION

CENTRADOL 100MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

CENTRADOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving CENTRADOL 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

CENTRADOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. CENTRADOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving CENTRADOL 100MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CENTRADOL 100MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How CENTRADOL 100MG INJECTION Works

CENTRADOL 100MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use CENTRADOL 100MG INJECTION

CENTRADOL 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
