name: TAZOWIN Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About TAZOWIN INJECTION

TAZOWIN INJECTION contains Pentazocine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opiate Analgesics. TAZOWIN INJECTION is used to relieve moderate to severe pain. It may also be used for pre-operative or pre-anesthetic medication and as a supplement to surgical anesthesia. Avoid consuming alcohol, tobacco, and smoking while receiving TAZOWIN INJECTION as it can increase the side effects.

Do not receive TAZOWIN INJECTION if you have severe asthma, trouble breathing, or other breathing problems, heart problems, bowel blockage or narrowing of the stomach or intestines, severe pain in the abdomen due to acute appendicitis or pancreatitis, acute respiratory depression, head injury, a risk for seizures, undergone a surgery or are planned to undergo a surgery therefore, consult your doctor before receiving. TAZOWIN INJECTION should be used with caution in patients who have severe kidney, liver and lung disease, heart disease, migraines, chronic or severe constipation, thyroid, adrenal or prostate gland disorders, low blood pressure, psychiatric problems such as depression, hallucinations or other mental problems, consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

TAZOWIN INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women until necessary, therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it. TAZOWIN INJECTION is not recommended for administration in children and adolescents less than 12 years of age, consult your doctor for advice. TAZOWIN INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, therefore consult your doctor before receiving. The most common side effects after receiving TAZOWIN INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, sedation, sweating, dizziness, euphoria and light-headedness. Consult your doctor immediately in case any of the side effects worsen or you experience an allergic reaction after receiving TAZOWIN INJECTION.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving TAZOWIN INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Zolpidem, estazolam (medicines used for the management of sleep disorders)
Anxiolytics and tranquillizers such as alprazolam, chlordiazepoxide (medicines used for the management of anxiety disorders)
Muscle relaxants such as chlorzoxazone, metaxalone (medicines used for muscle relaxation and management of muscle pain)
General anaesthetics such as isoflurane, propofol (medicines used during major surgeries for pain management)
Haloperidol, trifluoperazine and phenothiazines such as chlorpromazine (medicines used for the management of schizophrenia)
Antihistamines such as cetirizine, levocetirizine (medicines used for the management of allergic conditions)
Antiemetics such as ondansetron, dolasetron (medicines used for the management of vomiting)
Beta-blockers (medicines used for the management of high blood pressure)
Monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) such as selegiline, phenelzine (medicines used for the management of depression and mood disorders)
Opiate agonists such as methadone, morphine (medicines used for the management of moderate to severe pain)
Diuretics such as spironolactone, amiloride, frusemide (medicines used for the management of high blood pressure and oedema)
Hyoscyamine, Glycopyrrolate (medicines used for the management of various problems such as urinary incontinence, overactive bladder (OAB), chronic obstructive pulmonary disorder (COPD), certain types of poisoning)
Citalopram, fluoxetine (medicines used for the management of depression)
Mixed agonist/antagonist and partial agonist opioid analgesics such as butorphanol, nalbuphine, buprenorphine (medicines used for the management of moderate to severe pain)
Medicines used to manage migraines such as triptans
St. John's Wort (herbal medicine)

Overdosage:

TAZOWIN INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse immediately in case you experience any unusual symptoms. Symptoms of overdose are somnolence, respiratory depression, low or high blood pressure, increased heartbeat, hallucinations or seizures.

introduction:
Introduction About ULTRACET 325/37.5MG TABLET

ULTRACET 325/37.5MG TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ULTRACET 325/37.5MG TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ULTRACET 325/37.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ULTRACET 325/37.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ULTRACET 325/37.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ULTRACET 325/37.5MG TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ULTRACET 325/37.5MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRACET 325/37.5MG TABLET Works

ULTRACET 325/37.5MG TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRACET 325/37.5MG TABLET

Take ULTRACET 325/37.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ULTRACET 325/37.5MG TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Postadol 100mg Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About POSTADOL 100MG INJECTION

POSTADOL 100MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

POSTADOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving POSTADOL 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

POSTADOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. POSTADOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving POSTADOL 100MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of POSTADOL 100MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How POSTADOL 100MG INJECTION Works

POSTADOL 100MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use POSTADOL 100MG INJECTION

POSTADOL 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NOBLIGAN 50MG INJECTION

NOBLIGAN 50MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

NOBLIGAN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving NOBLIGAN 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

NOBLIGAN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. NOBLIGAN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving NOBLIGAN 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOBLIGAN 50MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How NOBLIGAN 50MG INJECTION Works

NOBLIGAN 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use NOBLIGAN 50MG INJECTION

NOBLIGAN 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: DOL Proxyvon SR 50mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE

DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE Works

DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE

Take DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with moderate liver problems and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE.
Do not take DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Tapentadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). It should be used with caution in patients having other breathing issues (slow or shallow breathing). Consult your doctor before taking DOL PROXYVON SR 50MG CAPSULE.

Introduction About TRD CONJECT 50MG INJECTION

TRD CONJECT 50MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TRD CONJECT 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TRD CONJECT 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRD CONJECT 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRD CONJECT 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRD CONJECT 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRD CONJECT 50MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRD CONJECT 50MG INJECTION Works

TRD CONJECT 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRD CONJECT 50MG INJECTION

TRD CONJECT 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About BUPRIGESIC INJECTION

BUPRIGESIC INJECTION contains Buprenorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioid Analgesics. It is used to provide relief from moderate to severe pain in affected individuals.

Pain is an uncomfortable sensation in the body that stems from the activation of the nervous system which generally occurs as an annoying/debilitating sensation, characterized by symptoms such as sharp, dull, throbbing, pinching, stinging, and/or burning sensation in the affected individuals.  

It is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Buprenorphine or other opiates (having morphine-like action). Before receiving BUPRIGESIC INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have breathing problems, suffer from fit/seizures, depression, renal impairment, liver problems or had undergone cardiac surgery.       

Opioids can lead to addiction, particularly when used for a long period of time and it may cause withdrawal symptoms (such as restlessness, difficulty sleeping, irritability, agitation, palpitation, etc.) when stop receiving this medicine suddenly.

BUPRIGESIC INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, including infants (aged below 6 months). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving BUPRIGESIC INJECTION. 

The common side effects associated with the use of BUPRIGESIC INJECTION are constipation, headache, nausea, urinary retention and sedation. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Introduction About BUPREPLAST 10MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH

BUPREPLAST 10MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH contains Buprenorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Strong analgesics. It is used to provide relief from moderate long-lasting pain that requires the use of a strong painkiller in affected individuals.

Pain is an uncomfortable sensation in the body that stems from the activation of nervous system which generally occurs as an annoying or debilitating sensation generally characterized by symptoms such as as a sharp, dull, throbbing, pinching, stinging and/or burning sensation in affected individuals.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while using BUPREPLAST 10MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH. This medicine is not recommended for use in patients with breathing problems, addiction to drugs and/or myasthenia gravis (condition that weakness muscles). Before using [GNKEYWORD], inform your doctor if you suffer from sleep apnoea (a breathing related sleep disorder), severe liver problems and/or kidney diseases.

BUPREPLAST 10MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women which is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

The most common side effects associated with the use of BUPREPLAST 10MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH are headache, dizziness, drowsiness, constipation, nausea, vomiting and itchy skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Provides relief from moderate long-lasting pain
mechanismOfAction:
How BUPREPLAST 10MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH Works

BUPREPLAST 10MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH works by blocking certain receptors (responsible for pain) in the brain and spinal cord which leads to blockade of pain transmission thus providing relief from moderate and long-lasting pain in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use BUPREPLAST 10MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH

Use BUPREPLAST 10MCG TRANSDERMAL PATCH as advised by your physician. Wash and dry the area where the transdermal patch must be placed. Choose a non-irritated, intact skin, relatively hairless or nearly hairless skin area on your upper arm, outer arm, upper chest, upper back, or side of the chest to apply the patch. The sticky side of the patch is protected with a silvery protective foil which is carefully removed without touching the sticky part of the patch. Stick the patch on to the chosen area of the skin and remove the foil.

Press the patch against the skin with your palm and count to 30 seconds slowly. Ensure, the whole patch is in contact with your skin, especially at the edges. The patch should be worn for seven days. Avoid exposing the patch to extreme heat. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION

TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION Works

TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

How to use TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION

TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women planning to have a baby because the baby may become dependent and may show withdrawal symptoms after the birth. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION.

TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and will affect the baby. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impaired reaction after receiving TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION.
Do not consume alcohol while receiving TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION as it may increase the effects of this medicine.
TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION.
TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION.
Do not receive TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines)

Before receiving TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shock state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION to your child.

Use in geriatrics:

TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving TRAMBAX 100MG INJECTION.

name: Hextradol P Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About HEXTRADOL P TABLET

HEXTRADOL P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. HEXTRADOL P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking HEXTRADOL P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

HEXTRADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breastfeeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

HEXTRADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking HEXTRADOL P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of HEXTRADOL P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How HEXTRADOL P TABLET Works

HEXTRADOL P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use HEXTRADOL P TABLET

Take HEXTRADOL P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take HEXTRADOL P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Fatigue, sweating
Vomiting, headache
Constipation
Dry mouth
Somnolence (feeling of sleepiness, drowsy or low in energy)
Uncommon
Effects on the heart and blood circulation (pounding of the heart, fast heartbeat, feeling faint or collapse during upright position or under physical strain)
Retching (urge to be sick)
Trouble stomach (such as feeling of pressure in the stomach, bloating and diarrhoea)
Skin reactions (such as rash and itching)
Rare
Slow heart rate, elevated blood pressure
Changes in appetite
Abnormal sensations (such as itching, tingling and numbness)
Trembling, epileptic fits, muscle twitches, uncoordinated movement
Transient syncope (loss of consciousness), speech abnormalities
Hallucinations, sleep disorders, delirium, anxiety and nightmares
Mood changes (mostly high spirits, occasionally irritated mood)
Changes in activity (such as slowing down or increase in activity)
Decreased cognitive and secondary perception (changes in senses and recognition which leads to errors in judgment)
Muscle weakness
Blurred vision, dilated pupils
Pain and difficulties in passing urine or low urine output

Slow or shallow breathing, confusion, sleepiness, small pupils, severe nausea and or constipation, constipation and lack of appetite
Serotonin syndrome (signs include agitation, hallucination, coma, fever, increase in heart rate, unstable blood pressure, involuntary twitching, muscular rigidity, lack of coordination, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea)
Difficulty breathing, rash or itchy skin, swollen face or tongue or difficulty in swallowing
Sleep-related breathing disorders or hypoexmia (signs include breathing pauses during sleep, night awakening due to shortness of breath, difficulties to maintain sleep or excessive drowsiness during the day)

ZAMADOL 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving ZAMADOL 100MG INJECTION.
Do not receive ZAMADOL 100MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

ZAMADOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines)

Before receiving ZAMADOL 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shock state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

ZAMADOL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). introduction:
Introduction About ZYROTRAM SEMI TABLET

ZYROTRAM SEMI TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ZYROTRAM SEMI TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ZYROTRAM SEMI TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ZYROTRAM SEMI TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ZYROTRAM SEMI TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ZYROTRAM SEMI TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZYROTRAM SEMI TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ZYROTRAM SEMI TABLET Works

ZYROTRAM SEMI TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ZYROTRAM SEMI TABLET

Take ZYROTRAM SEMI TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ZYROTRAM SEMI TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About TRANZAT INJECTION

TRANZAT INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TRANZAT INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TRANZAT INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRANZAT INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRANZAT INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRANZAT INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Uses Of TRANZAT INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRANZAT INJECTION Works

TRANZAT INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

TRANZAT INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ZYROTRAM P RAPID TABLET

ZYROTRAM P RAPID TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ZYROTRAM P RAPID TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ZYROTRAM P RAPID TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ZYROTRAM P RAPID TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ZYROTRAM P RAPID TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ZYROTRAM P RAPID TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZYROTRAM P RAPID TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ZYROTRAM P RAPID TABLET Works

ZYROTRAM P RAPID TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ZYROTRAM P RAPID TABLET

Take ZYROTRAM P RAPID TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ZYROTRAM P RAPID TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About ONTADOL INJECTION

ONTADOL INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

ONTADOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving ONTADOL INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

ONTADOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. ONTADOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving ONTADOL INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ONTADOL INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ONTADOL INJECTION Works

ONTADOL INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use ONTADOL INJECTION

ONTADOL INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DOL PROXYVON 50MG TABLET

DOL PROXYVON 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

DOL PROXYVON 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

DOL PROXYVON 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

DOL PROXYVON 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. DOL PROXYVON 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking DOL PROXYVON 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOL PROXYVON 50MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How DOL PROXYVON 50MG TABLET Works

DOL PROXYVON 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. DOL PROXYVON 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use DOL PROXYVON 50MG TABLET

Take DOL PROXYVON 50MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug–Drug Interactions:

Before taking DOL PROXYVON 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Sedatives such as zolpidem, barbiturates (Ex. amobarbital, pentobarbital) antidepressants such as paroxetine, sertraline and anti-psychotics such as loxapine, clozapine, monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) such as isocarboxazid (used to manage depression, anxiety, mood disorders, sleep disturbances)

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of DOL PROXYVON 50MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Introduction About SUPRIDOL 50MG INJECTION

SUPRIDOL 50MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

SUPRIDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving SUPRIDOL 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

SUPRIDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. SUPRIDOL 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving SUPRIDOL 50MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SUPRIDOL 50MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How SUPRIDOL 50MG INJECTION Works

SUPRIDOL 50MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use SUPRIDOL 50MG INJECTION

SUPRIDOL 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TDOL PLUS 500/50MG TABLET

TDOL PLUS 500/50MG TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TDOL PLUS 500/50MG TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TDOL PLUS 500/50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TDOL PLUS 500/50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TDOL PLUS 500/50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TDOL PLUS 500/50MG TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TDOL PLUS 500/50MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TDOL PLUS 500/50MG TABLET Works

TDOL PLUS 500/50MG TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

How to use TDOL PLUS 500/50MG TABLET

introduction:
Introduction About BIOTRAM INJECTION

BIOTRAM INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

BIOTRAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving BIOTRAM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

BIOTRAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. BIOTRAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving BIOTRAM INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BIOTRAM INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How BIOTRAM INJECTION Works

BIOTRAM INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use BIOTRAM INJECTION

BIOTRAM INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines)

introduction:
Introduction About LUPIGESIC OLD 0.3MG INJECTION

LUPIGESIC OLD 0.3MG INJECTION contains Buprenorphine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioid Analgesics. It is used to provide relief from moderate to severe pain in affected individuals.

Pain is an uncomfortable sensation in the body that stems from the activation of the nervous system which generally occurs as an annoying/debilitating sensation, characterized by symptoms such as sharp, dull, throbbing, pinching, stinging, and/or burning sensation in the affected individuals.  

It is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Buprenorphine or other opiates (having morphine-like action). Before receiving LUPIGESIC OLD 0.3MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have breathing problems, suffer from fit/seizures, depression, renal impairment, liver problems or had undergone cardiac surgery.       

Opioids can lead to addiction, particularly when used for a long period of time and it may cause withdrawal symptoms (such as restlessness, difficulty sleeping, irritability, agitation, palpitation, etc.) when stop receiving this medicine suddenly.

LUPIGESIC OLD 0.3MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, including infants (aged below 6 months). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving LUPIGESIC OLD 0.3MG INJECTION. 

The common side effects associated with the use of LUPIGESIC OLD 0.3MG INJECTION are constipation, headache, nausea, urinary retention and sedation. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How LUPIGESIC OLD 0.3MG INJECTION Works

LUPIGESIC OLD 0.3MG INJECTION works by blocking certain receptors (responsible for pain) in the brain and spinal cord which leads to the blockade of pain transmission thus providing relief from moderate/severe pain in affected individuals.

LUPIGESIC OLD 0.3MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein as a slow intravenous injection or into the muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FENT 50MCG INJECTION

FENT 50MCG INJECTION contains Fentanyl which belongs to the group of medicine called Opioid Analgesics. It is used in the management of severe pain. It provides pain relief during and after short surgical procedures.

During major surgical procedures, it is commonly used prior to and along with certain anesthetics (Ex. halothane, sevoflurane) and neuroleptic medicines to induce and maintain anesthesia (loss of sensation) and/or pain relief. It is frequently used to supplement anaesthetics which permits the use of anaesthetic at low doses.

Before receiving FENT 50MCG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma or any other breathing problems, muscle weakness, thyroid deficiency, severe undiagnosed headaches, alcoholism or a previous history of drug abuse as a precaution.

If you are currently taking or recently took any sleeping pills or medicines used for depression, make sure to inform your doctor before FENT 50MCG INJECTION is given to you.

The most common side effects of receiving FENT 50MCG INJECTION are pain and swelling at the site of injection, nausea, vomiting, muscle stiffness, headache, dizziness, drowsiness, low blood pressure, blurred vision, low pulse, wheezing or breathing difficulties. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ULTRAMED INJECTION

ULTRAMED INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

ULTRAMED INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving ULTRAMED INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

ULTRAMED INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. ULTRAMED INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving ULTRAMED INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ULTRAMED INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ULTRAMED INJECTION Works

ULTRAMED INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use ULTRAMED INJECTION

ULTRAMED INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: ULTRAMED INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women planning to have a baby because the baby may become dependent and may show withdrawal symptoms after the birth. Consult your doctor before receiving ULTRAMED INJECTION.
ULTRAMED INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and will affect the baby. Consult your doctor before receiving ULTRAMED INJECTION.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impaired reaction after receiving ULTRAMED INJECTION.
Do not consume alcohol while receiving ULTRAMED INJECTION as it may increase the effects of this medicine.
ULTRAMED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving ULTRAMED INJECTION.
ULTRAMED INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving ULTRAMED INJECTION.
Do not receive ULTRAMED INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

ULTRAMED INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines)

Before receiving ULTRAMED INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shock state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

ULTRAMED INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of ULTRAMED INJECTION to your child.

Use in geriatrics:

ULTRAMED INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving ULTRAMED INJECTION.

introduction:
Introduction About AISHWIN INJECTION

AISHWIN INJECTION contains Pentazocine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opiate Analgesics. AISHWIN INJECTION is used to relieve moderate to severe pain. It may also be used for pre-operative or pre-anesthetic medication and as a supplement to surgical anesthesia. Avoid consuming alcohol, tobacco, and smoking while receiving AISHWIN INJECTION as it can increase the side effects.

Do not receive AISHWIN INJECTION if you have severe asthma, trouble breathing, or other breathing problems, heart problems, bowel blockage or narrowing of the stomach or intestines, severe pain in the abdomen due to acute appendicitis or pancreatitis, acute respiratory depression, head injury, a risk for seizures, undergone a surgery or are planned to undergo a surgery therefore, consult your doctor before receiving. AISHWIN INJECTION should be used with caution in patients who have severe kidney, liver and lung disease, heart disease, migraines, chronic or severe constipation, thyroid, adrenal or prostate gland disorders, low blood pressure, psychiatric problems such as depression, hallucinations or other mental problems, consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

AISHWIN INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women until necessary, therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it. AISHWIN INJECTION is not recommended for administration in children and adolescents less than 12 years of age, consult your doctor for advice. AISHWIN INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, therefore consult your doctor before receiving. The most common side effects after receiving AISHWIN INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, sedation, sweating, dizziness, euphoria and light-headedness. Consult your doctor immediately in case any of the side effects worsen or you experience an allergic reaction after receiving AISHWIN INJECTION.

usesDetails:
Uses Of TRICARE INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRICARE INJECTION Works

TRICARE INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

TRICARE INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

mechanismOfAction:
How NICODOL INJECTION Works

NICODOL INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. name: Zyrotram 100mg Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION

ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION Works

ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION

ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women planning to have a baby because the baby may become dependent and may show withdrawal symptoms after the birth. Consult your doctor before receiving ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION.

ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and will affect the baby. Consult your doctor before receiving ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impaired reaction after receiving ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION.
Do not consume alcohol while receiving ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION as it may increase the effects of this medicine.
ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION.
ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION.
Do not receive ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (fits) which is not properly controlled by the management
Have withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines)

Before receiving ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have a head injury or breathing difficulties
Have a feeling of fainting
Are in a shock state (cold sweat may be a sign)
Are addicted to certain medicines (such as opioids or prescription medicines) and alcohol
Tend to develop fits
Have a history of suffering from withdrawal symptoms such as agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating (when stopped taking drugs or alcohol)
Have signs of adrenal insufficiency (low levels of cortisol) such as extreme fatigue, lack of appetite, severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting or low blood pressure

Use in paediatrics:

ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION to your child.

Use in geriatrics:

ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving ZYROTRAM 100MG INJECTION.

introduction:
Introduction About DOLO T TABLET

DOLO T TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. DOLO T TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking DOLO T TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

DOLO T TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

DOLO T TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking DOLO T TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOLO T TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How DOLO T TABLET Works

DOLO T TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use DOLO T TABLET

Take DOLO T TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take DOLO T TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About SUPRIDOL INJECTION

SUPRIDOL INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

SUPRIDOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine- like medicines).

Before receiving SUPRIDOL INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shock state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

SUPRIDOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. SUPRIDOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving SUPRIDOL INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

Uses Of SUPRIDOL INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How SUPRIDOL INJECTION Works

SUPRIDOL INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

SUPRIDOL INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

SUPRIDOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). It is also not recommended for children having breathing problems because the toxicity of this medicine will be worse in these children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of SUPRIDOL INJECTION to your child.

SUPRIDOL INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years). Consult your doctor before receiving SUPRIDOL INJECTION.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving SUPRIDOL INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:  

Benzodiazepines (medicines used to manage anxiety or sleep problems) Ex. diazepam, lorazepam
Anticoagulants (medicines used to manage or manage blood clots) Ex. warfarin
Carbamazepine (used to manage fits)
Ondansetron (used to manage or manage nausea)
Monoamine oxidase inhibitors (medicines used to manage depression) Ex. moclobemide, phenelzine and selegiline (used to manage parkinson’s disease)
Other medicines used to manage pain (Ex. pentazocine, buprenorphine, morphine, codeine)

Overdosage:

SUPRIDOL INJECTION will be administered to you only by a physician or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your physician if you experience any unusual symptoms. Overdosage symptoms of SUPRIDOL INJECTION are excessive constriction of pupil of the eye, vomiting, cardiovascular collapse, consciousness disorders up to coma, convulsions, respiratory depression up to respiratory arrest and serotonin syndrome (a serious drug reaction).
